Position Title::Staff Software Engineer
Job Description
Our automotive software team is looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer for the productization stream. You will be focusing on CICD of our automotive reference software stack for our next generation compute subsystems in the context of software-defined vehicles enabled with artificial intelligence (AI). You will lead technical initiatives across engineering domains and work closely with our software leads, architects as well as program and project management to deliver robust, optimized systems that shows the outstanding capabilities of our platforms.
We seek outstanding engineers who are passionate about building amazing teams which at the same time enjoy the exposure to various parts of the system software stack, from bare metal firmware to middleware and application development.
If you are similarly excited about groundbreaking technologies as we are, and you want to help us forming an amazing team here at Arm, we want to hear from you.
Roles and Responsibilities
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will architect and evolve scalable CI/CD and software productization infrastructure for firmware, drivers, and low-level system software. The role drives build, integration, automated testing, packaging, and release automation to enable reliable and efficient software delivery. A key responsibility is enabling continuous delivery by ensuring pipelines remain stable, available, and release-ready at all times. This includes improving pipeline observability, proactively identifying failures, driving rapid recovery, and continuously improving delivery efficiency and developer productivity. The role also involves building automation and test infrastructure, solving hardware-software integration challenges, and providing technical leadership across firmware, system, integration, validation, and infrastructure teams. Responsibilities include developing and reviewing high-quality Python and Bash code, while taking end-to-end ownership from architecture and implementation through deployment and sustained operation.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering with 12+ years of experience in SoC/embedded software development and CI/CD across the semiconductor development lifecycle.
Strong hands-on experience in system firmware development, with proficiency in Embedded C and Python and/or Bash. Solid understanding of Linux, Arm architectures, open-source software development, versioning, licensing, SDL, and software delivery, complemented by strong system-level debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
Good experience in architecting and maintaining scalable CI/CD infrastructure for large, multi-component repository structures, build systems, dependency management, variant management, automated testing, packaging, and release automation.
Proven experience enabling continuous software delivery, with a strong focus on pipeline availability, stability, automation, observability, rapid failure recovery, and release readiness!
Strong end-to-end technical leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across teams and drive continuous improvement.
Desirable Skills & Qualities
Experience with embedded software ecosystems and technologies such as Zephyr, Yocto, Bazel, Copybara, Git, Jenkins, Repo-structures, test automation framework, DevOps, C++, or Rust.

Experience working in automotive, robotics, functional safety, embedded security, or other sophisticated SoC/system domains.

Come and make an impact at scale!

Lead and develop a team of software engineers at your site, providing technical direction, coaching and career development while remaining hands-on in solving complex engineering challenges.
Drive system validation and productisation for Infrastructure System Solutions, establishing effective validation plans, quality criteria and approaches to product readiness.
Advance scalable test infrastructure, CI, regression capabilities and quality metrics to improve coverage, efficiency and confidence throughout the development lifecycle.

Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.

What You’ll Bring 
Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.
A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential (strongly preferred) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential.
A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.
A track record of independently solving ambiguous, novel problems, from defining an approach through overcoming obstacles and driving resolution. Curiosity to understand how processes actually work and keep learning as the business changes.
Clear written and verbal communication, including concise, accurate, auditor-ready memos and actionable recommendations. Confidence partnering with senior stakeholders and external auditors, including working through pushback.
A practical, innovative approach to helping the business adopt new technologies, products, and ways of working while maintaining compliance. Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and validating their output.

On Time Hook Up of Production tools

Coordinate filter maintenance, airflow verification, and critical environmental alarms to protect yield‑sensitive operations.

Lead corrective and preventive actions following incidents, audits, or near‑miss events.

Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.

Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.

Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.

Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.

Act as the site’s voice in global facilities forums to align with corporate standards.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or equivalent.
12–15+ years of experience in semiconductor fab facilities or similar high‑reliability industrial environments.
Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.

Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management
Multi-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Process, and Equipment teams
Data‑driven reliability improvement
Typical benchmarks
Fab utility uptime
Safety & EHSS compliance score
Incident response time
PM compliance rate
Cost optimization vs budget

jobs.description:
About NCR Atleos
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
Company profile
NCR Atleos is a global leader in self-service financial access and ATM solutions, providing technology and services to financial institutions and retailers. The company supports ATM deployment, maintenance, managed services, cash management, transaction processing infrastructure, and end-to-end ATM operations.
For the PNB Dispute Management Executive position, the role contributes to operational accuracy and customer service by supporting transaction verification, ATM reconciliation, excess cash investigation, CIT coordination, CCTV verification, and timely closure of GL, suspense, and sundry differences.
Position Summary
The Dispute Management Executive will be responsible for the day-to-day reconciliation, and closure of ATM transaction disputes and related operational differences for the PNB process. The role requires timely investigation of failed transactions, excess cash cases, reconciliation differences, and suspense/sundry items while coordinating with relevant internal and external stakeholders for resolution.
Key Areas of Responsibility
1, Failed Transaction Verification
Perform daily verification of failed ATM transactions.
Investigate transaction discrepancies and ensure timely resolution of identified exceptions.
2 Excess Cash Verification
Check and validate excess cash through C3R and Electronic Journal (EJ) counters.
Identify discrepancies between transaction records and reported cash positions.
3 CIT Follow-up
Follow up with the CIT team/vendor when excess cash is not reported.
Obtain the reason, confirmation, and acceptance for identified excess cases and track them through closure.
4 CCTV Verification
Review CCTV footage for suspected or disputed transaction cases wherever investigation requires visual verification.
Maintain appropriate records/evidence in accordance with applicable process requirements.
5 Daily Reconciliation
Perform reconciliation across Core Banking System (CBS), C3R closing balances, and Switch records.
Investigate mismatches and coordinate for timely resolution of reconciliation differences.
6 GL Difference Closure
Monitor and resolve General Ledger (GL) related differences.
Ensure open reconciliation items are appropriately investigated, documented, and closed within defined timelines.
7 Suspense & Sundry Management
Review and work on suspense and sundry files.
Follow up on outstanding entries and ensure timely closure of pending items with appropriate supporting documentation.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in banking operations, ATM operations, transaction reconciliation, or dispute management.
Working knowledge of transaction reconciliation and exception handling.
Ability to analyze transaction-level discrepancies and follow cases through to closure.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in ATM dispute management, reconciliation, or banking operations.
Practical knowledge of C3R, EJ, Switch, GL, suspense, and sundry reconciliation.
Experience coordinating with CIT agencies/vendors for cash-related discrepancies.
Understanding of failed ATM transactions, excess cash investigation, and transaction dispute processes.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reconciliation and data analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple cases and meet TATs.

jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
As a Warehouse Lead, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of inbound and internal warehouse operations, including receiving of materials, storage, inventory management, cycle counting and on-time fulfilment of manufacturing floor requirements. You will lead a team of warehouse associates on the shop floor, ensuring that every material is received, stored, issued and accounted for accurately in the system, and that production lines never stop due to material unavailability.
You will drive a culture of 6S, safety, discipline and continuous improvement in the warehouse, and act as the first point of contact for Production, Planning, Quality, Procurement and Finance teams on material-related matters during your shift.
1. Receiving of Materials
Plan and manage inbound dock schedule, vehicle unloading and material receipt as per PO, ASN, invoice and packing list
Ensure physical verification of quantity, part number, lot/batch, date code and packaging condition before acceptance
Ensure timely GRN / goods receipt posting in ERP/WMS (e.g., SAP) within defined TAT
Coordinate with Incoming Quality (IQC) for inspection, and segregate quarantine, hold, rejected and damaged material
Handle receiving discrepancies (shortage, excess, damage, wrong part) and raise them with Procurement, Supplier and Logistics teams
Ensure correct handling of ESD-sensitive, moisture-sensitive, temperature-controlled, shelf-life and hazardous materials as per SOP
Ensure labelling and barcode identification of all received material before put-away
2. Storage and Location Management
Ensure system-directed put-away of material to correct bin/location within defined TAT
Maintain bin location master and optimise space utilisation (racking, slotting, fast/slow movers)
Ensure storage conditions are met (temperature, humidity, ESD, dry cabinets, segregation of hazardous material)
Enforce FIFO / FEFO and monitor shelf-life and expiry of materials
Ensure safe stacking, material handling equipment usage and load-bearing limits
Identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete and expired stock for disposition
3. Inventory Management and Cycle Count
Maintain 100% system-to-physical inventory accuracy for all materials under warehouse custody
Plan and execute daily/weekly cycle counts based on ABC classification and the approved cycle count calendar
Investigate count variances, perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions
Process inventory adjustments with proper approval and documentation as per Finance and audit requirements
Support periodic wall-to-wall physical inventory, internal audits and external/statutory audits
Monitor stock levels and raise alerts for shortages, critical parts and excess inventory to Planning and Procurement
Ensure all inventory transactions (receipt, transfer, issue, return, scrap) are recorded accurately and on time
4. Fulfilment of Manufacturing Floor Requirements
Ensure on-time and accurate issue of materials to the production floor as per work order, material requisition, kitting list and production plan
Plan picking, kitting and line-feeding / replenishment (Kanban, min-max) to ensure zero line stoppage due to material
Coordinate with Production and Planning on daily build plan, priority changes and urgent requirements
Manage return of unused, excess and rejected material from the floor with proper system transactions
Track and escalate material shortages, and follow up with Planning, Procurement and Suppliers for closure
Ensure traceability of issued material (lot/batch/reel ID) to work orders
5. 6S, Safety and Housekeeping
Implement and sustain 6S (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardise, Sustain, Safety) across the warehouse
Conduct daily 6S walks and periodic 6S audits; track and close observations
Ensure visual management – floor marking, location labels, signage and display boards
Ensure compliance with EHS requirements, PPE usage, MHE (forklift, stacker, pallet jack) safety and safe material handling
Report near-misses, unsafe acts and unsafe conditions, and drive corrective actions
Ensure ESD compliance in material storage and handling areas
6. Team Leadership
Lead, allocate and monitor daily work of warehouse associates and material handlers in the shift
Conduct shift start meetings / Tier-1 huddles covering safety, priorities, KPIs and issues
Train team members on SOPs, system transactions, safety, ESD and 6S; maintain skill matrix and training records
Monitor attendance, productivity and discipline; provide feedback, coaching and recognition
Support the Supervisor in manpower planning, shift handover and performance reviews
Drive teamwork, ownership and a "right first time" culture
7. Systems, Compliance and Continuous Improvement
Follow and maintain warehouse SOPs, work instructions and documentation; support SOP updates
Ensure compliance with quality, customs/bonded warehouse (where applicable), audit and statutory requirements
Prepare and publish daily/weekly warehouse reports and KPI dashboards
Identify process gaps and lead Kaizen, Lean and error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) improvements
Support RCA and CAPA for warehouse-related incidents, customer/internal complaints and audit findings
Support system enhancements, barcode/scanner usage and digital tools (WMS, Power BI, Copilot) for efficiency
Using Artificial Intelligence
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) :
Inventory record accuracy (system vs. physical)
Cycle count plan adherence and variance closure
GRN / receiving TAT and put-away TAT
On-time, in-full material issue to production (zero line stoppage due to material)
Picking / issue accuracy
6S audit score
Safety – zero lost-time incidents; near-miss reporting and closure
Audit findings – zero major non-conformance
Team training completion and skill-matrix coverage
Education Desired :
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Commerce or related field
Certification in Lean, 6S, Inventory Management or Warehouse Operations is an advantage
Experience Desired :
4–7 years of experience in warehouse / stores operations in a manufacturing environment (semiconductor, electronics, automotive or similar preferred)
Minimum 2 years in a team lead / shift lead role
Hands-on experience in receiving, inventory control, cycle counting and production line feeding
Skills and Competencies :
Working knowledge of ERP/WMS (SAP MM/WM/EWM preferred), barcode and RF scanning systems
Good understanding of inventory control principles – FIFO/FEFO, ABC analysis, min-max, Kanban
Knowledge of 6S, Lean, Kaizen and basic problem-solving tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D)
Knowledge of ESD, MSL and safe material handling practices; MHE operation awareness

jobs.description:

Position: Mechanical Engineer – Water Systems
Experience: 7–12 Years
Location: Ahmedabad / Sanand, Gujarat
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer – Water Systems to support the operation and optimization of industrial water and wastewater utility systems. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) systems (preferred), and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) processes. The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable, efficient, and compliant utility operations.
Key Responsibilities
* Manage and optimize Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) facilities.
* Person should have proficiency in using Gen AI Tools, Copilot, Copilot library & Agent bots.
* Monitor plant performance and identify opportunities for process optimization, energy efficiency, and water conservation.
* Ensure compliance with statutory environmental regulations and discharge norms.
* Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies for pumps, valves, piping systems, filtration units, membranes, evaporators, crystallizers, and associated equipment.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Support capacity expansion, debottlenecking, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Prepare technical reports, SOPs, maintenance procedures, and project documentation.
* Ensure adherence to EHS standards, risk assessments, and safe work practices.
Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* 7–12 years of relevant experience in industrial water utility systems.
* Hands-on experience with Water Treatment, Wastewater Treatment, STP, ETP, and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems.
* Strong understanding of pumps, piping systems, heat exchangers, pressure vessels, filtration systems, membrane technologies (UF/RO), evaporators, and crystallizers.
* Experience in commissioning, troubleshooting, and operation of water utility systems.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental regulations and water quality standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, PFDs, P&IDs, and equipment datasheets.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and project coordination skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in semiconductor, pharmaceutical, chemical, petrochemical, or other high-tech manufacturing facilities.
* Familiarity with Ultra Pure Water (UPW) systems.
* Knowledge of automation, PLC/SCADA-based water utility controls.
* Experience with water balance studies, process optimization, and sustainability initiatives.
* Certification in project management or water treatment technologies is an added advantage.
Key Competencies
* Water & Wastewater Treatment Systems
* Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)
* Mechanical Utilities

* Evaporation & Crystallization Systems
* Process Optimization

jobs.title: Facilities Operation Manager
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Job Purpose
The Facilities Operations Manager is responsible for continuous, safe, and compliant operation of all fab facilities and critical utilities supporting semiconductor manufacturing. This includes bulk and high-purity gas distribution systems, chemicals, Ultra‑Pure Water (UPW), wastewater treatment, HVAC and cleanroom environmental control, electrical systems, and building infrastructure in a 24×7,
This role directly impacts yield, uptime, safety, and customer audit outcomes.
Core Responsibilities
Fab Facilities & Critical Utilities Operations
Lead operations of bulk & specialty gas systems, chemical distribution systems, UPW, process cooling water, wastewater treatment, Electrical System, Building Infrastructure HVAC, and cleanroom environmental systems.
Ensure continuous availability of all utilities required for Manufacturing with minimal production impact.
Own facility incident response and serve as first responder for site‑wide facilities events.
2. Cleanroom & Environmental Control
Maintain clean room temperature, humidity, pressure, and contamination control within fab‑defined limits.
Coordinate filter maintenance, airflow verification, and critical environmental alarms to protect yield‑sensitive operations.
Support particulate, AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination), and vibration control programs aligned with fab standards (as referenced in semiconductor cleanroom roles).
3. EHSS & Regulatory Compliance
Ensure full compliance with EHSS, hazardous gas, chemical safety, wastewater discharge, and environmental regulations concerning semiconductor manufacturing.
Maintain 100% EHSS training certification for all facilities staff and contractors.
Lead corrective and preventive actions following incidents, audits, or near‑miss events.
4. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop facilities technicians, engineers, and supervisors in a shift‑based 24×7 operation.
Drive standardization of operating procedures, maintenance practices, and commissioning processes.
Implement succession planning and skill‑depth development for critical systems ownership.
5. Maintenance, Reliability & Performance Management
Establish and govern preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all fab utilities and infrastructure.
Leverage artificial intelligence to track and drive KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, response time, safety metrics, and PM compliance
Lead root‑cause analysis (RCA) for utility‑related excursions impacting production.
6. Commissioning, Projects & Expansion Support
Lead commissioning of new fab utilities, equipment, and facility expansions supporting ramp‑up or technology node changes.
Partner with construction, operational, and equipment groups to integrate facilities systems with minimal disruption.
7. Financial & Vendor Management
Own facilities operations budget, forecasting, and cost‑optimization initiatives.
Handle strategic vendors providing gas, chemical, UPW, waste, and maintenance services.
Ensure contract compliance and SLA alignment for critically important services.
8. Customer & Audit Readiness
Represent the site during customer audits, ISO, EHSS, and certification reviews.
Act as the site’s voice in global facilities forums to align with corporate standards.
Qualifications & Experience
Required
Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) or equivalent.
12–15+ years of experience in semiconductor fab facilities or similar high‑reliability industrial environments.
Proven understanding of gases, chemicals, UPW, wastewater systems, Electrical System, HVAC, and cleanroom facilities.
Preferred
Exposure to BMS / FMS / CMMS / SCADA systems.
Knowledge of local and international EHSS standards applicable to semiconductor fabs.
Key Competencies
Mission‑critical operations leadership
Safety‑first perspective
Incident & emergency management
Multi-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, Process, and Equipment teams
Data‑driven reliability improvement
Typical benchmarks
Fab utility uptime
Safety & EHSS compliance score
Incident response time
PM compliance rate
Cost optimization vs budget

jobs.title: Senior Energy and Decarbonization Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
Energy Strategy and Management
Develop and successfully implement a site energy strategy aligned with business, sustainability, cost reduction, decarbonization, and corporate environmental goals. Set annual and long-term targets for energy consumption, energy intensity, renewable energy, and cost optimization.
Prepare detailed energy roadmaps covering efficiency, electrification, renewable energy, storage, demand management, and low-carbon technologies. Conduct detailed energy reviews to identify SEUs, operational variables, and energy-saving opportunities.
Establish and maintain Energy Baselines, EnPIs, energy performance tracking, budgets, forecasts, and renewable energy demand forecasts. Analyze utility consumption versus production, utilization, operating hours, weather, and other variables. Support energy security, grid reliability, alternate supply arrangements, and energy price risk management. Lead ISO 50001 implementation and employ Agentic AI for renewable energy dashboards.
B. Projects in Renewable Energy
Identify, evaluate, and implement renewable energy projects including Rooftop/Ground-mounted Solar PV, Wind and Solar-Wind Hybrid, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Captive and Group-Captive Projects, Third-Party Open Access Arrangements, Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) and Environmental Attributes. Conduct technical and commercial feasibility studies by reviewing load profiles, contracted demand, grid connectivity, land availability, and future demand. Prepare project concepts, scope, specifications, generation estimates, and cases supporting project viability. Evaluate proposals based on cost, tariff savings, reliability, environmental benefits, and regulatory feasibility. Coordinate due diligence, project progress, commissioning, performance testing, monitoring, and handover. Monitor generation, availability, degradation, curtailment, contractual performance, and renewable energy claims. Maintain project register, capacity, generation, CODs, and benefits delivered.
C. PPAs & Open Access
Evaluate Physical PPAs, Virtual PPAs, Open Access PPAs, Captive/Group-Captive models, and On-site Renewable Agreements. Develop load forecasts and procurement scenarios. Prepare RFIs/RFPs and assess tariff, blocking issue, tenure, capacity, generation profile, banking, wheeling, transmission, scheduling, forecasting, and settlement. Perform financial analysis including NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity, and landed-cost comparison. Assess regulatory, market, counterparty, curtailment, generation, credit, and change-in-law risks. Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, and Legal teams on negotiations and contracts. Review contractual clauses including capacity, tariff, term, COD, guarantees, supply commitments, payment security, change in law, force majeure, default, termination, and renewable attribute ownership. Monitor invoices, energy credits, open-access charges, and regulatory changes.
D. ISO 50001 Energy Management System
Lead the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ISO 50001 EnMS. Define EnMS scope and boundaries, identifying static factors and variables affecting energy performance. Integrate energy considerations into the building, procurement, equipment selection, and modifications. Conduct awareness programs, training, audits, compliance reviews, management reviews, and certification audits.
Manage non-conformities, corrective actions, closure evidence, and documentation. Coordinate with corporate and site energy teams.
E. Energy Awards & Efficiency Projects
Participate in energy awards and competitions. Identify energy conservation opportunities in Chillers & Cooling Towers, HVAC/AHUs/MAUs, Compressed Air Systems, Process Cooling Water, Vacuum Systems, Electrical Distribution, Transformers & UPS, Cleanroom Ventilation & Filtration, Exhaust & Abatement Systems, Pumps, Fans & Motors, Lighting Systems, and Manufacturing & Testing Equipment. Evaluate VFDs, efficient motors, heat recovery, heat pumps, automation, advanced controls, power management, and demand-response systems.
F. Energy Data & Digitalization
Develop dashboards for renewable generation, energy cost, and project savings. Prepare monthly energy scorecards and management reports. Ensure accuracy, traceability, retention, and compliance of energy data for regulatory, ISO, ESG, and financial reporting.
G. Regulatory & Collaborator Management
Track electricity, renewable energy, captive power, open access, and energy-efficiency regulations. Collaborate with utilities, regulators, agencies, consultants, transmission entities, and load-dispatch centers. Assist with approvals, compliance, scheduling, banking, wheeling, captive status, and renewable energy procurement. Keep approvals, agreements, invoices, energy accounting, and compliance records up to date. Act as the organization’s representative in technical discussions, audits, consultations, ESG disclosures, and sustainability reporting.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy, Environmental Engineering, or related fields. Solid understanding of industrial utilities, energy systems, and renewable electricity procurement.
Preferred
Master’s/Postgraduate qualification in Energy Management, Power Systems, Renewable Energy, Sustainability, or MBA or equivalent experience. Certified Energy Manager (CEM) / Certified Energy Auditor (CEA). ISO 50001 Lead Implementer/Auditor certification.
Experience Requirements
10-14 years in industrial energy management, renewable energy, or electricity procurement. 4-5+ years in energy-intensive industries such as Semiconductor, Electronics, Automotive, Pharmaceutical, Chemical, Process Industries, or Large Manufacturing Facilities. Experience in ISO 50001 implementation/maintenance, Renewable PPAs, Open Access, Captive & Group-Captive projects, Energy baselines, EnPIs, SEUs, action plans, Energy audits, metering systems, dashboards, savings verification, collaboration with developers, utilities, regulators, and consultants, ISO audits, management reviews, corrective actions.
Technical Knowledge & Skills
ISO 50001:2018 EnMS, Renewable energy project development, Solar, Wind, Hybrid & Energy Storage Technologies, Physical & Virtual PPAs, Open Access & Captive Power Models, Tariff and Landed-Cost Analysis, Energy Baselines, EnPIs & SEUs, Load Profiling & Demand Forecasting, Measurement & Verification (M&V), Financial Modelling & Lifecycle Costing, GHG Accounting (Purchased Electricity Emissions), Contract & Commercial Risk Assessment, Advanced Excel, Analytics Tools & Dashboards, Facility Monitoring & Building Management Systems (BMS).
Behavioral Proficiencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, Commercial and contractual awareness, Structured project management, Negotiation and partner management, Ability to convert technical analysis into management recommendations, High attention to data integrity and documentation, Cross-functional collaboration with EHS, Facilities, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Manufacturing teams.

jobs.description:

Job description
Function: Mechanical
Location: Sanand
Experience: 12 to 15 Years
Qualification: Mechanical Engineering, Bachelor of Engineering degree
Industry Preference: Semiconductor Plant
The role requires an experienced engineer to lead the composition coordination, quality implementation, and installation oversight for all utility hook-up systems connected to semiconductor manufacturing tools. The candidate should be capable of handling cross-functional coordination for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems while ensuring conformity with engineering standards, cleanroom requirements, Working on AI-Enabled tools (such as Copilot and Power BI), safety rules, and project timelines.
Role purpose
This position is responsible for end-to-end coordination of tool hook-up works, from building review through installation, inspection, testing, and handover. In semiconductor projects, tool hook-up is a critical integration stage because each production tool must be accurately connected to utilities such as electrical power, process gases, chilled or process water, DIW, drain system, exhaust, and communication/data systems before startup and qualification can begin.
Key responsibilities
Review tool utility requirements and coordinate hook-up development for mechanical, electrical, network, water, and gas systems.
Verify layouts, installation drawings, hook-up packages, utility routing, and interface points with tool suppliers, facility teams, and project collaborators.
Manage field implementation of tool hook-up operations and verify adherence to approved drawings, quality plans, and safety guidelines.
Coordinate installation activities related to power supply, earthing, cables, data/network connectivity, water lines, gas lines, mechanical supports, and associated utility connections.
Ensure cleanroom protocols, contamination control practices, and semiconductor installation standards are maintained during execution.
Support QA/QC activities including inspections, punch listing, leak testing, pressure testing, continuity checks, flushing, and utility verification.
Work with OEMs, construction teams, quality teams, and facility engineers during startup, commissioning support, interlock verification, and handover.
Prepare and maintain engineering documentation such as checklists, as-built drawings, progress reports, inspection records, deviation logs, and turnover dossiers.
Apply industrial engineering methods to improve workflow, resource planning, installation sequencing, productivity, and execution efficiency.
Identify execution risks, resolve field issues, and drive corrective and preventive actions to maintain schedule and quality targets.
Required qualifications
Mechanical Engineering degree
12–15 years of experience in managing projects, facilities engineering, tool installation, or tool hook-up activities is required.
Strong knowledge of building review, field execution, quality assurance, and coordination across multidisciplinary utility systems is required.
Proficiency with AI tools (such as Copilot and Power BI) is required.
Preferred experience in semiconductor plants, cleanroom environments, or high-tech manufacturing facilities.
Ability to understand engineering drawings, utility layouts, P&IDs, single-line diagrams, and hook-up documents is preferred.
Working knowledge of testing, commissioning support, turn-on documentation, and vendor coordination is required.
Good communication, planning, team coordination, and problem-solving skills are essential.
Preferred candidate profile
The ideal candidate should have direct experience with semiconductor projects and a solid understanding of facility backbone systems. These include power, water, gas, and mechanical utilities that support fab operations. Candidates with cleanroom tool hookup, OEM coordination, utility interface management, and efficiency improvement experience are especially suited. You will perform reliability testing and data analysis on material associated with sustaining qualifications through change requests, product proliferations, special work requests and conversions. You will also take part in the management of product deviation events, through participation in product containment activities and providing quality and reliability evaluation plans for risk assessment.
You will also manage the outgoing quality and reliability (OQRM) metrics. You are expected to conduct failure analysis from qualification, evaluation and OQRM failures and report the resulting data. You can expect to conduct global meetings to determine product priorities or product dispositions.

Take part in containment activities
Determine a reliability evaluation/trials plan
Identify and manage material for sampling
Perform data analysis of reliability tests results and/or by conducting failure analysis
Determine disposition of materials
Close out evaluation and provide feedback to stakeholders
Manage and coordinate various inputs from various stakeholders in Quality Reliability

jobs.title: Staff, Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Job Purpose: Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to, and own the quality of what ships. EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users. The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt. Responsibilities: Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision. Qualify incoming asks: challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership. Work closely with business teams, prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads. Required skills: 16+ years of overall professional experience & 10+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments. Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage. Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features. Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production. Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject. A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted. Education : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred skills: Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler. Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX. Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Skills AI Platforms, AI Systems, Data Analysis, Full Stack Development, Machine Learning (ML), ML Platforms, Model Evaluation, Performance Analysis, Product Delivery, Product Design, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Framework Integrations
jobs.description: AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members. The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires. You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day — we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Position expectations Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance. Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve. Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further. Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles. Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness. Own the operational health of the integrations you build — monitoring, upgrades, breaking-change response, issue triage, and follow-through after launch. Partner with the Database Experience (DBX) org to define the driver, platform, and product capabilities your integrations depend on, making the case for what's needed and why. Work with product management, product design, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers to define the first version and future evolution of these integrations. Raise the technical bar within the team: shape architecture and development practices, give thorough code reviews, share what you know, and mentor peers and less experienced engineers. Stay current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems and bring what you learn back to the team's roadmap. Bring a research and discovery mindset: notice emerging opportunities in the ecosystem, surface them early, and make the case for where MongoDB should show up next. Flag issues, risks, and resource needs early and clearly, both within the team and to cross-functional partners in other regions. Qualifications Strong background in building core components for scalable, high-availability services, developer platforms, or libraries 7+ years of experience building backend systems or developer-facing libraries, with strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, and performance tuning software in large, long-lived code bases, including code that other developers depend on Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions, and delivering complex projects independently with minimal guidance A product-minded approach to engineering, with the judgment to make pragmatic tradeoffs between fast time-to-market and long-term maintainability, and the comfort to operate amid ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies Demonstrated ability to context switch across a portfolio of projects while maintaining sound prioritization and quality. Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas. Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, including the ability to write things down clearly for partners you won't always overlap with in real time. Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest. Eager to learn, with a strong technical background. Nice to Have Meaningful open source contributions, especially work that landed in repositories you don't own and required navigating external maintainer review Professional experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it Experience building and operating CI/CD and automated testing infrastructure for libraries with many downstream version and platform combinations Experience working with databases and knowledge of database internals; query optimization experience, especially with MongoDB Experience with vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and tooling Experience instrumenting usage telemetry and using it to guide investment decisions Familiarity with Jira and related tool Success measures In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, the high-level architecture of our integrations, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and the key technical dependencies around your work. You'll know who to go to in DBX and product, and you'll have landed your first meaningful code contribution In three months, you will own a significant integration or workstream end to end, have landed upstream contributions and established working relationships with the relevant external maintainers, and be contributing to how the team tests and releases its work In six months, you will have delivered a new integration or major capability that customers are using, improved the health and maintainability of the portfolio you own, and be a trusted voice in deciding where the team invests next In twelve months, you will be the recognized technical owner of a meaningful area of the portfolio, will have shaped architectural decisions and engineering practices beyond your own projects, and will be actively influencing the forward-looking technical strategy for how MongoDB shows up in the AI framework ecosystem About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer. Req ID- 3273512145

jobs.title: Data Science Expert
jobs.description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What You'll Build The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll build and scale the layer that makes that possible. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers into unified semantic layers. Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Develop AI capabilities including generative AI and LLM-based solutions using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Work with cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP to support reliable, scalable AI workflows. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. Required Qualifications What you'll bring 10+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, semantic data systems, applied AI, or data science in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field Hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies and semantic models; proficiency in at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL); understanding of trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in agile environments. Preferred Qualifications Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end. (SAP knowledge is a strong accelerator) Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Deep expertise across the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) and/or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL). Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, with experience developing, evaluating, and improving models on real-world datasets. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, or shared AI services adopted across multiple product areas. Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks across complex application landscapes. Understanding of HR/HCM domain semantics and the ability to translate SuccessFactors business concepts, processes, and terminology into semantic models, knowledge representations, AI grounding, and agentic experiences. Experience working with SAP SuccessFactors extensibility and integration technologies, including OData APIs, Integration Center, SAP BTP, and/or other SAP integration patterns. Experience applying analytics, machine learning, or statistical methods to workforce use cases such as attrition, headcount, workforce planning, skills, compensation, recruiting, performance, engagement, or talent intelligence. Where you belong Join SAP SuccessFactors at a pivotal point in the evolution of enterprise AI, where we are moving beyond traditional applications and analytics toward intelligent, autonomous agents that can understand HCM context, reason over trusted business data, and help customers make better workforce decisions. As part of the SuccessFactors Line-of-Business, you will work at the intersection of HCM domain expertise, enterprise data, applied AI, and agentic technologies—helping shape how employees, managers, HR leaders, and businesses interact with SAP through intelligent experiences. You will collaborate with product, engineering, data, and research teams to ground autonomous agents in SuccessFactors business processes, semantics, policies, and data, while building solutions that are accurate, responsible, secure, and scalable. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact problems across the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and talent to workforce planning, analytics, and people intelligence, and to play a foundational role in defining the next generation of AI-powered HCM at SAP. #dlhiring Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. jobs.title: Generative AI Forward Deployed Engineer, Google Cloud
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role. Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions. Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)). Experience leading technical discovery sessions. Preferred qualifications: Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation). Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing. About The Job As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Responsibilities Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable return on investment (ROI). Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team. Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency. Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams. Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Responsibilities Gathering and analyzing user/client requirements to create the software requirements specification (SRS) document. Writing and implementing source codes of embedded systems and enhancing code samples of existing systems. Testing and debugging embedded system software using different tools/methods available to improve code quality and optimize system performance. Collaborating with other teams to provide post production support. Degree Requirement: Requires a Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum. Skill Descriptors: Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge: Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance. Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions. Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns. Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand. Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge: Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. Teamwork: Knowledge of the necessity and value of teamwork; experience with; ability to work cooperatively towards shared goals and being supportive of others at all levels. Level Working Knowledge: Explains own role and responsibility within team. Actively participates in team meetings. Shares information, knowledge, and experiences openly and proactively. Describes team mission and objectives in the context of results to be achieved. Demonstrates open, friendly, accepting, and supportive behaviors with team members. Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Working Knowledge: Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components. Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services. Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence. Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues. Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. Level Working Knowledge: Describes common tools for component-based, object-oriented development. Describes the objectives, activities and results of unit testing. Has developed programs in a specific language and for a specific platform. Interprets functional and technical blueprints; participates in structuring technical components. Participates in technical and code reviews. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge: Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements. Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis. Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements. Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements. Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis. System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Basic Understanding: Describes major components of system testing used by the organization. Documents the standard processes and procedures involved in system testing. Explains the importance of thorough system testing prior to implementation. Identifies common errors that occur in standard system testing activities. Responsibilities Lead discovery and architecture discussions with customers to translate business and IT requirements into ServiceNow solutions. Integrate ServiceNow solutions with enterprise platforms, applications and operational processes. Being You The Kyn in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That's The Kyndryl Way. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years of experience, Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise ServiceNow solutions. Strong architecture skills covering requirements analysis, solution design, integration, security, resilience and technical viability. Preferred Skills and Experience Experience with ServiceNow AI and agentic/GenAI-driven automation capabilities. Software engineering experience involving APIs, integrations, scripting, source control, CI/CD or DevOps practices, consistent with the engineering foundation expected of an FDE. Experience leading complex transformation, ITSM modernisation or enterprise workflow automation engagements. Advanced ServiceNow certifications relevant to the candidates architecture specialisation. jobs.title: Gen AI Architect || Pune & Noida
jobs.description:
Experience range: 9-14 Yrs
Greetings!!! Please find below Job Description: Job Summary We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams. The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards. Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work. Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams. Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components. Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks. Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs. Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements. Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team. Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems. Enterprise System Architecture Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems. Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends. Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery. Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to architect AI workloads on cloud platforms (Azure preferred: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML) with appropriate cost and performance optimisation. Data Engineering & AI Data Architecture Design and govern data pipelines supporting AI model inference and (where applicable) fine-tuning: ingestion, transformation, quality validation, and versioning. Define data architecture for AI: vector databases, knowledge graphs, embedding stores, and structured/unstructured data integration patterns. Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data pipelines meet quality, freshness, and compliance requirements for AI use cases. Responsible AI, Governance & Security Embed AI fairness, transparency, explainability, and accountability principles into solution designs from inception. Define and enforce AI security architecture: prompt injection protection, data leakage prevention, model access controls, and audit logging. Ensure compliance with applicable AI governance frameworks, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and enterprise AI policies. Conduct AI risk assessments for new solutions and advise teams on responsible deployment practices. Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication Collaborate closely with executive stakeholders, product managers, business analysts, and engineering leads to align AI architecture with business strategy and product roadmaps. Present complex AI architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences; produce architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts. Actively contribute to the broader IAIS architecture community sharing learnings, patterns, and innovations across teams and programs. Mandatory Qualifications & Skills Architecture & Engineering Foundation Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field. Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect (5+ years), with a track record of designing large-scale, production enterprise systems. Strong command of system design principles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, cloud-native patterns. Experience architecting across cloud platforms, with strong preference for Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure API Management). Generative AI & Agentic AI Expertise Deep hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI application development including RAG architecture, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and chain-of-thought design. Proven experience architecting Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent. Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, and LLMOps practices including tracing tools, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring. Experience with vector databases and embedding stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, FAISS, Chroma, or similar). Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA) and when to apply them versus prompt-based adaptation. Programming & Technical Skills Strong Python proficiency able to prototype, review, and guide implementation of GenAI components. Working knowledge of software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). Responsible AI & Governance Sound knowledge of Safe AI principles, AI security patterns, AI governance frameworks, and data privacy compliance. Ability to conduct AI risk assessments and embed governance into architecture decisions. Communication & Leadership Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions and drive consensus across multi-disciplinary teams. Effective at communicating architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences. Experience mentoring developers and guiding teams through complex AI implementation challenges . Preferred Qualifications Experience leading AI architecture across multiple concurrent teams. Familiarity with MLOps tooling and platforms (MLflow, Azure ML Pipelines, Weights & Biases). Exposure to multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech-to-text, document AI). Experience with enterprise AI governance and compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or equivalent). Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or custom coding agents). Prior experience in a product architecture role delivering Industry AI Solutions at enterprise scale. ABOUT GENERAL MILLS We make food the world loves: 100 brands. In 100 countries. Across six continents. With iconic brands like Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Hagen-Dazs, weve been serving up food the world loves for 155 years (and counting).
