Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. OVERVIEW The Sitecore Content Hub Developer will be part of a product team responsible for designing, developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting enterprise digital asset and content management capabilities on Sitecore Content Hub.The role will work closely with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, platform engineers, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable Sitecore Content Hub solutions. The individual will provide technical leadership to developers, guide implementation decisions, participate in design and code reviews, and support the platform through delivery and production operations. The role requires strong experience with Sitecore Content Hub, digital asset management concepts, content models, workflows, metadata, integrations, and software engineering practices. The person will also contribute to platform modernization, automation, performance improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Project Participation Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through deployment and support. Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into Sitecore Content Hub solutions. Configure and develop Content Hub entities, schemas, taxonomies, metadata models, policies, workflows, actions, and user roles. Design and implement integrations between Sitecore Content Hub and enterprise systems using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven patterns. Develop and maintain custom extensions, scripts, automations, and platform configurations where appropriate. Contribute to technical design documents, architecture discussions, sprint planning, and task-level estimation. Perform technical design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and security requirements. Conduct code reviews and ensure maintainable, reusable, and standards-compliant code. Lead or contribute to deployment, release, environment promotion, and configuration management activities. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes. Monitor and improve application and integration performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with other teams to identify dependencies, manage risks, and resolve technical issues. Manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality and delivery commitments. Provide application support on a rotation basis, including on-call support where required. Learning and Development Stay current with Sitecore Content Hub capabilities, product releases, DAM practices, integration patterns, and relevant industry trends. Mentor and coach team members to build technical depth and platform expertise. Drive process improvements at the project and team level. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, reading groups, demonstrations, and technical communities of practice. Participate in hiring, onboarding, and capability development activities. Continue to strengthen communication, collaboration, consulting, and leadership skills. Consulting Provide module and project effort estimates. Recommend technical solutions and explain trade-offs to stakeholders. Act as a Sitecore Content Hub technical subject-matter expert. Develop functional expertise in digital asset management, content operations, product information, or a related business domain. Serve as a liaison between business analysts, product owners, architects, and developers. Answer implementation questions and provide technical direction throughout delivery. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Full-Time Bachelor's degree with minimum 10-15 years of total work experience. Demonstrated ability to build a work plan or contribute to a work plan appropriate to the role. Experience implementing small projects or contributing to medium- or large-scale enterprise technology projects. Hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub, preferably including Content Management, Digital Asset Management, Product Content Management, or related modules. Experience configuring Content Hub data models, schemas, taxonomies, relations, metadata, workflows, roles, permissions, and business rules. Experience with Sitecore Content Hub APIs, REST services, webhooks, integrations, and authentication mechanisms. Experience developing or configuring integrations with enterprise applications, cloud services, middleware, or data platforms. Strong understanding of DAM concepts, including asset lifecycle management, renditions, versioning, metadata governance, rights management, and content distribution. Proficiency in object-oriented programming and at least one modern programming language such as C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Working knowledge of .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL, JSON, XML, and HTTP-based services. Experience with source control, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment practices, and Agile delivery. Good working knowledge of the enterprise application and technical tools landscape. Ability to proactively resolve issues, take ownership, and work across multiple tasks and teams. Ability to become a go-to resource for the team or business group. Experience with third-party integrations and enterprise system interfaces. Provide senior-level technical leadership by shaping designs, reviewing code, strengthening engineering standards, collaborating across product and technology teams, and advising business partners. Design, develop, and support scalable Sitecore Content Hub capabilities for the reliable management and organization of digital assets and product content. Configure and extend Content Hub data models, schemas, taxonomies, relationships, metadata, workflows, roles, permissions, and business rules to support effective content governance. Design and maintain integrations between Content Hub and enterprise applications, cloud services, middleware, data platforms, and third-party systems, using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, messaging/event-driven services, or equivalent technologies. Develop solutions using object-oriented programming and modern practices with technologies such as C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, JSON, and XML. Apply DAM expertise across the asset lifecycle, including renditions, versioning, rights management, content quality, and distribution. Build secure, maintainable services using Content Hub APIs, REST, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and other HTTP-based interfaces. Establish and execute quality-engineering practices, including unit, integration, automated, performance, and regression testing, supported by effective CI/CD and deployment processes. Deliver initiatives across the full software-development lifecycle, contribute to medium- and large-scale enterprise projects, and resolve production issues through root-cause analysis and durable fixes. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Sitecore Content Hub certification or formal Sitecore training. Experience with Sitecore XM Cloud, Sitecore Experience Platform, or other Sitecore products. Experience with Sitecore Content Hub One, Content Operations, or DAM platform migration. Experience with product information management, product data, or master data concepts. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or GCP. Experience with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, messaging platforms, or equivalent integration services. Experience with DevOps tooling, infrastructure automation, observability, and application monitoring. Familiarity with accessibility, security, privacy, and enterprise content governance standards. Experience with performance testing, unit testing, automated integration testing, and quality engineering. Experience working with global, distributed, and cross-functional teams. ELIGIBILITY Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, PaySec, StoreSec
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it. Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default. As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be. You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. Second, detection agents: AI-assisted services that find sensitive data, vulnerable patterns, and risky configurations across production. Third, onboarding acquired stacks: tooling that brings newly acquired businesses onto Amazon's standard engineering and security platforms. You will work side by side with security engineers, and your work will show up directly in fewer vulnerabilities and less time builders spend fixing them. As a senior engineer, you will set the technical direction for the team's systems, lead designs that span multiple components and teams, and mentor other engineers. Key job responsibilities Lead the architecture and technical direction of the team's security tooling, and make trade-offs between precision, coverage, latency, and builder experience. Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, highly available services that handle sensitive payments data. Build controls-as-code and code-creation security rules that catch common vulnerability patterns before code is merged. Build AI-assisted detection agents that find sensitive payment data and vulnerable code patterns across production applications, with high precision. Build tooling that onboards acquired businesses' code, cloud accounts, and pipelines onto Amazon's standard security tooling. Build automated remediation that proposes or writes the fix for a finding, not just flags it, so builders spend minutes instead of days. Meet directly with security engineers and service teams to understand their requirements, and design solutions that make them more productive. Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and roll out changes that meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability. Work with security engineers to turn threat models and findings into automated mechanisms. Contribute to operational excellence through code reviews, testing, monitoring, and on-call. Lead designs that span multiple teams, including integration with Amazon's central security and developer platforms. Work with stakeholders to gather and document requirements, and take part in strategic planning for the team's roadmap. Grow and coach engineers on the team, and raise the bar in design and code reviews. A day in the life You will spend most of your time building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and shipping. You will pair with security engineers who bring a threat model or a class of findings, and together you will decide what can be automated and how to measure that it works. You will meet the service teams who use our tools, hear where security slows them down, and fix it. The team runs regular architecture reviews and knowledge shares, and you will learn security from people who do it every day. About the team IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience developing and delivering security software tools Expertise in security and permission management systems, such as AWS IAM and AWS Organizations. Experience building with large language models or AI agents in production. Proven programming ability in Java, C++, Python, Go, TypeScript, or related. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Experience with Liquibase or Flyway for schema versioning. Experience with event-driven architecture (Pub/Sub, Kafka). Familiarity with Maven multi-module builds and shared library management. Background in financial services, risk management, or regulatory technology. Understanding of model risk management concepts (model validation, tiering, governance). Experience migrating or modernizing legacy platforms. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com . Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology. Our Core Beliefs: Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning. Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things. Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success. Integrity: We act ethically and honestly. Position Summary: Unisys is looking for a seasoned Cybersecurity Auditor, based in India and part of the global CISO team, who will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and independently plan, execute and drive cybersecurity audits across the organisation’s security, infrastructure, application and cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on technical depth. The role partners with the CISO, GIS, Infrastructure (CIT) and Business Unit teams across the globe through the full audit lifecycle: scoping, planning, execution, reporting and remediation tracking. The role demands strong stakeholder and leadership engagement. The candidate will present audit results and risk exposure to senior management and the CISO, negotiate findings and remediation timelines, and handle challenging stakeholders across regions and cultures with credibility, objectivity and composure, while keeping the audit programme on schedule. The candidate will provide regular status updates on audits to senior management, highlighting key risks, challenges and the actions being taken to address them. Working relationship with Internal and External Teams Work with the CISO and GIS and CIT teams globally – Infrastructure, Applications, Security Architecture, GIS Leadership team, Security Operations team Work with BISOs of the four Business Units and Business Unit leadership across regions Work with other global CISO team members, and with Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as required External – Certifying agencies, vendors, client auditors, client account teams and external audit firms Key Responsibilities: Plan and Execute Cybersecurity Audits – 65% Independently own and drive end-to-end cybersecurity audits as the SME, from scoping to closure, with minimal supervision. Manage the internal security audit programme based on requirements from international standards such as ISO, NIST, NIST-CSF, NIS2, Cyber-Essentials Plus, PCI, SSAE 18 etc. using a risk-based audit approach. Prepare, review and maintain the annual audit calendar, audit plans, audit management documentation and audit lifecycle in line with risk priorities and business commitments across regions. Define audit scope, objectives, criteria and sampling approach in consultation with the CISO, GIS and CIT teams. Perform audits based on criteria defined in ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, ISO 20000, NIST, NIST-CSF, NIS2,, SSAE 18 SOC1/SOC2, SOX, Cyber-Essentials Plus, PCI-DSS etc., including audit planning, evidence gathering, field notes and documentation of findings. Perform technical audits for various security domains, for example Vulnerability and Patch Management, Identity and Access Management, Application Development, DevSecOps, Network and Infrastructure Security, Security Operations and Incident Response, Crisis Management and BC/DR. Perform cloud security audits across Azure, AWS and GCP environments, covering identity and access management and privileged entitlements, network segmentation and perimeter controls, data protection (encryption and key management), logging and monitoring, security configuration and posture, and the shared responsibility model. Audit cloud-native and modern platform controls, including container and Kubernetes security, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code, and SaaS/PaaS security, against criteria such as CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM and NIST. Use technical testing and data analysis (configuration reviews, scripts, CLI and query-based evidence collection, log analysis) to validate controls rather than relying only on documentation and interviews. Work with GIS teams to identify the scope of infrastructure and application services to be covered by technical audits. Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness, perform root cause analysis, and assess the risk rating and business impact of findings. Stakeholder Engagement, Reporting and Remediation – 20% Lead audit kick-off, execution, closing and status meetings with IT, infrastructure, security teams and business units, working across global time zones. Prepare clear, risk-focused audit reports and executive summaries and review them with stakeholders and leadership on a regular basis. Hold leadership-level conversations with the CISO and senior management on audit results, risk exposure and trends, and escalate unresolved or high-risk issues in a timely way. Manage difficult or resistant stakeholders across regions: negotiate and agree findings, remediation plans and timelines, and drive accountability for closure. Track remediation actions to closure, validate the evidence of fixes, and report on overdue items and repeat findings. Audit Programme Governance and Continuous Improvement – 15% Track audit metrics and KPIs, identify recurring themes, and recommend improvements to the control environment. Continuously improve audit methodology, templates and workpapers, and monitor changes in standards, regulations and the threat landscape that affect the audit plan. Include AI security in audit scope and work with AI governance to ensure AI security requirements are covered by audits. Mentor junior team members and share audit best practices with the global CISO team. Overall experience of 12–15 years, with at least 6 years of technical experience working on infrastructure or application systems. Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity and IT audits based on industry standards, including leading audits independently as a subject matter expert. Must have performed technical audits hands-on, including at experience in auditing cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP). Demonstrated experience in the full audit lifecycle (scoping, planning, fieldwork, reporting and remediation follow-up) and in risk-based audit methodologies. Experience working in a global organisation with stakeholders across regions, cultures and time zones. Technical Skills Strong technical depth in at least four of the following: Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability and Patch Management, Network and Infrastructure Security, Application Security and DevSecOps, Security Operations and Incident Response, BC/DR, Data Protection and Cryptography. Hands-on knowledge of cloud security architecture and controls on Azure, AWS or GCP, including IAM and privileged access, network security, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and security posture management; multi-cloud exposure is preferable. Working Knowledge of CSPM, EDR, IAM, Vulenerability Management tools like Wiz, Crowdstrike, MS Defender, MS Entra, Tenable, etc Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code security, and operating system, database and network device hardening. Working knowledge of ITGC and SSAE 18 SOC1/SOC2. Working knowledge of SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53 and CIS Benchmarks is preferable. Knowledge and experience in AI security and AI security audits. Working knowledge of GRC and compliance automation tools for Audits, Risks Management Certifications Must have CISA and CISSP certification (or equivalent senior-level security certification). Cloud security certification, for example CCSP, Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), AWS Certified Security – Specialty or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, is strongly preferred. jobs.title: Sr Serviceability Engineer - Life Cycle Manager (LCM)
jobs.description: About Nutanix Nutanix is building a world where infrastructure is invisible, and organizations can focus on the work that matters. Our hybrid multicloud platform helps customers run applications and manage data across private, public, and distributed clouds with simplicity and control. About the Team The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. The team is made up of engineers who improve product serviceability, diagnostics, reliability, and the overall customer experience. Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate. You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership. Your Role As a Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM) , you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption. LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues. The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities. What You’ll Do Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics. Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early. Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency. Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models. Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement. Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses. Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure. Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance. Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected. Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios. Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement. Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations. Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions. Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk. What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations. Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders. Technical Requirements Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation. Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios. Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance. Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi. Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance. Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus. Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis. Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns. Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred. Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation. Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling. Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows. Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues. Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios. Serviceability and Quality Engineering Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products. Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk. Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria. Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution. Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data. Preferred Qualifications Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms. Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments. Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing. Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards. Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products. Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material. Why This Role Matters Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution. If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products. Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. About the Team The Identity and Access Management team is responsible for building a secure, reliable, and seamless identity platform for all Postman users. This team owns the systems behind authentication, session management, access control, service accounts, invites, and other foundational identity capabilities that power the product. Postman’s identity layer is a critical part of the product experience. It sits on the path of every authenticated request and enables users, teams, and systems to access Postman securely and collaborate effectively. The team works on a mix of core platform improvements, new product capabilities, and reliability/security investments. What You’ll Do Build and maintain backend systems that power Postman’s identity and authentication platform. Work with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to scope, implement, test, and launch new features and platform improvements. Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services and APIs. Improve system quality by writing tests, fixing bugs, and strengthening observability and monitoring. Participate in production support, debugging, incident investigation, and follow-through on fixes. Work on performance, scalability, and reliability improvements for the services owned by the team. Take ownership of well-defined projects and components, and drive them with support from senior engineers and your manager. Contribute to code reviews and team discussions, and adopt strong software engineering practices. Collaborate with other engineers to break down work, resolve ambiguity, and deliver iteratively. About You You have 2+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems in production environments. You have a solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, networking, and system design basics. You are comfortable writing clean, testable, maintainable code. You have experience working with backend services, APIs, and databases. You are able to work through ambiguity with guidance and ask the right questions to move work forward. You care about quality, reliability, and learning how systems behave in production. You collaborate well with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders. You have good written and verbal communication skills. You are curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a platform engineering environment. Technical Experience We Value Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, Go, or Ruby Familiarity with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure Experience building or maintaining microservices and APIs Familiarity with databases, caching, queues, or event-driven systems Exposure to testing, monitoring, debugging, and production support Familiarity with authentication, authorization, identity, RBAC, access control, or security-sensitive systems is a plus, but not required What Else? In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Create reusable prompt templates and prompt patterns for different business use cases. . Apply techniques including: Zero shot prompting Few shot prompting Structured prompting Contextual prompting Role/task based prompting Tool/function oriented prompting . Experiment systematically with different prompt structures, instructions and context. . Improve output accuracy, consistency, relevance and reliability. . Reduce hallucinations and undesirable model behaviour. . Optimise prompts considering quality, latency and token/cost efficiency. 2. Generative AI Solution Development . Define evaluation criteria covering: Accuracy Relevance Completeness Consistency Groundedness Hallucination Safety Response quality . Build representative evaluation datasets and test scenarios. . Conduct comparative testing across prompts, models and configurations. . Perform regression testing following prompt or model changes. . Analyse failure patterns and identify opportunities for improvement. . Establish measurable acceptance criteria before prompts are promoted into production. 4. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) . Work with engineering teams to design prompts for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. . Optimise how retrieved enterprise context is supplied to LLMs. . Design system and user prompts that encourage grounded responses based on approved information. . Support optimisation of retrieval and generation workflows. . Evaluate whether responses are properly grounded in retrieved source material. . Help identify whether poor results originate from retrieval, context, prompt design or the underlying model. 5. jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Summary You will design, build and operate production grade AI agents that talk to real customers. Working on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, you will own the reasoning, retrieval, tooling and guardrails behind services handling millions of conversations. This is applied AI engineering, taking systems from prototype to reliable, evaluated, governed production, not research. Client , Technology is a core driver of how we deliver our strategy. You'll join a team modernising our platforms, strengthening cyber and operational resilience, and advancing a product led way of working that brings engineers, data specialists and business experts together to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace. We're scaling automation and AI from proof of concept into real, end to end change, improving customer journeys, reducing cost to serve, accelerating delivery, and building the digital foundations that underpin everything from energy trading and risk to field operations and critical infrastructure. If you want to work on complex, high impact problems using modern engineering practices, and help build reusable platforms that will shape how Client operates over the next decade, this is the place to do it. An opportunity to play your part. You will join the Channel Platforms team, which owns Client 's customer conversation estate across voice, chat and email. Our agents are already live: a pay as you go voice assistant built on a real time speech to speech model, a multi channel customer facing agent spanning voice, chat and WhatsApp, and a standalone agentic webchat service running on AgentCore Runtime. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will own the intelligence layer of these products. That means the agent's reasoning and orchestration, the tools it can call, the knowledge it retrieves, the guardrails that constrain it, and the evaluation that proves it works. You will decide what good looks like and then build the measurement to show whether we are hitting it. This is a role for someone who has taken generative AI past the demo stage. Our problems are the hard ones that show up after launch: grounding answers in the right source, keeping voice latency low enough to feel natural, handing off to a human at the right moment, and proving to a governance board that the system behaves safely at scale. You do not need a contact centre background. If you are a strong engineer who has built real agentic systems on Bedrock or a comparable platform, we will teach you the domain. Location: UK based hybrid role, occasional travel to site. Day to day . Design and build agentic services on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore Runtime, including multi step orchestration, state and memory management, and graceful handling of failure and ambiguity. . Build and own the tool layer that agents act through, exposing business capability such as account lookup, billing and identity as reliable, well described actions with sensible error semantics. . Build retrieval augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases, taking ownership of content preparation, chunking, embedding strategy, retrieval quality and answer grounding. . Treat prompts as engineering artefacts. Version them, test them, and understand precisely what changed when behaviour shifts. . Build the evaluation harness. Define what accuracy, containment and safe behaviour mean for each product, assemble regression sets, and make it possible to ship a prompt or model change with evidence rather than optimism. . Implement guardrails and safety controls, including PII handling, out of scope refusal, jailbreak resistance and clean escalation to a human advisor. . Engineer for latency and cost. Streaming, model selection and routing, caching and token budgets all matter, and in voice they matter in real time where a pause of a few hundred milliseconds is felt by the customer. . Instrument agent behaviour end to end so that tool failures, retrieval misses and abandoned conversations are visible in Datadog and QuickSight, not discovered through complaints. . Support live AI services in production, investigating incidents and diagnosing non deterministic behaviour, then closing the loop with permanent fixes. . Make and document build versus buy calls, writing Architecture Decision Records and taking designs through our AI governance board and change control process. . Track how the generative AI landscape is moving and bring the parts that deliver clear benefit into the roadmap, with an honest read on the risk as well as the upside. What we need from you Essential: . Substantial software engineering experience, with strong Python. You write production code, not just notebooks. . Demonstrable delivery of LLM or agentic systems into production for real users, and the scar tissue that comes with it. We will ask what broke and what you changed. . Hands on experience with tool and function calling, multi step agent orchestration, and managing conversational state across turns. . jobs.description: Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com. Job Title: AI/ML Engineer Position: AI/ML Engineer Experience: 6+ Years Category: Software Engineer / Systems Analysis Main Location: Hyd/Ban/Che Position ID: J1126-1511 Employment Type: Full Time position Description We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Senior Generative AI & Agentic AI Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in building, deploying, and scaling enterprise AI solutions. This role will be responsible for designing, developing, and operationalizing secure, production-grade Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI solutions across enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem, including Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, and modern AI orchestration frameworks. Implement enterprise-grade security controls addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized agent actions, privacy regulations, auditability, and Responsible AI requirements. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, FAI Asset Creation Technology (FACT)
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Are you passionate about building software that makes a meaningful difference for millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will own and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle complex technical problems, bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, and craft solutions that are simple, maintainable, and built to scale. This is a role where your engineering contributions have direct, visible impact on the products and experiences our customers rely on every day. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on collaboration and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you. Key job responsibilities Design and implement software solutions that address customer needs, working across the full development lifecycle including scoping, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations. Write high-quality, well-documented, and maintainable code while actively participating in code reviews to provide meaningful feedback and mentor fellow engineers on your team. Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational processes and software reliability. Evaluate emerging tools and approaches—including generative AI capabilities—to recommend and adopt improvements that enhance productivity and solution quality. A day in the life Your morning might start with a design discussion where you sketch out the architecture for a new feature, weighing tradeoffs around scalability and maintainability with your teammates. After lunch, you could be deep in code, building and testing a component that will ship incrementally to customers. Between focused coding sessions, you review pull requests from peers, share constructive feedback, and help onboard a new team member by walking them through how your services operate and fit into the broader system. About the team Our team is committed to building reliable, customer-focused software that operates at Amazon scale. You can grow into a Senior Manager technical lead role without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Embedding Work in person in Chennai alongside a F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with an assigned Finance or GBS team. Learn the work through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, map the process, and find where AI removes effort, risk, or delay. Run discovery with business users and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Translate business pain points into scoped use cases with success measures agreed with the business owner. Work from Product Owner priorities and specifications, and shape them into buildable scope with the business owner. Push back when the request doesn’t match the underlying problem or it’s exposed to technical issues and limitation. Build & Ship Build agentic AI solutions end to end: agents and tools on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, other market leading runtimes and Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph, LangChain, MCP tool integrations, retrieval with Azure AI Search, document extraction with Document Intelligence, and the interfaces users touch. Deliver working prototypes in days and MVPs in weeks. Iterate directly with end users. Write production-quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with tests, version control, and code review. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow, and review AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. Build evaluation sets that prove accuracy on real finance data before release, and run them as regression tests on every change. Data & Enterprise Integration Connect solutions to enterprise Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools (or API) and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Write and tune SQL. Use and extend the shared F&GBS ontology, semantic views, and business rules instead of hard-coding logic in prompts. Follow data access, entitlement, and classification rules for financial and personal data. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Design solutions that hold up to SOX, Internal Audit, data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act), and EU AI Act review. Record agent evidence, approvals, and actions in the decision ledger, and build human review steps where AI outputs drive financial decisions. Apply Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, and output monitoring. Document design decisions, data lineage, and model behavior for control owners. Production & Handoff Own production readiness and ongoing support: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Deploy through approved pipelines on Pfizer cloud and GenAI platforms. Set up logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Contribute reusable components and patterns to the team’s shared library. Value & Adoption Track usage, accuracy, and hours saved. Report results to the business owner and FDE leadership. Train users and build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [6+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building LLM-based applications, including RAG, tool calling, or agents, with at least one solution in use by business users. Experience evaluating and testing LLM output quality. Hands-on Python coding at a production standard. Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern web framework such as React. Strong SQL and experience working with enterprise data platforms. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud services, API design, and CI/CD. Track record of working directly with business users to define and deliver solutions. Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Experience in a regulated industry, with exposure to SOX or IT general controls. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Developer or Solutions Architect or other market leading runtimes). Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours. Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption. jobs.title: Application Support Engineer
jobs.description: Project Role : Application Support Engineer Project Role Description : Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems. Must have skills : SAP PO/PI & APIs Development Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent Build AI native enterprise integration solutions using SAP Process Orchestration / Process Integration (PO/PI) and modern API-led connectivity. This role combines deep PO/PI integration engineering (interface design, mappings, adapters, monitoring) with agentic AI patterns (LLM + tools + retrieval + evaluation) to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and modernize legacy integration estates into measurable, production-grade integration products. Core Responsibilities 1) Enterprise Integration Engineering (PO/PI Core) Design and deliver end-to-end integrations across SAP and non SAP systems using PO/PI runtime capabilities. Build interface contracts (message types, service interfaces), implement routing, transformation, enrichment, correlation, and exception handling patterns. Develop and maintain integration artifacts in the repository and configuration layers, ensuring consistency and reusability. 2) Adapter & Connectivity Development Implement integrations using common enterprise adapters (e.g., IDoc, RFC, File/SFTP, HTTP/REST, SOAP, JDBC, JMS, Mail) depending on landscape requirements. Engineer secure connectivity patterns (certificates, credentials, encryption) and define transport-level controls aligned to enterprise policies. 3) Mapping & Transformation Engineering Build message mappings and operation mappings for complex transformation needs, including context-based routing, reusable mapping functions, and XSLT where required. Implement advanced transformation logic using Java mappings or script-based approaches when standard mappings are insufficient. Design canonical payloads to reduce point-to-point complexity and support long-term maintainability. 4) API Development & API-Led Integration Design, build, and expose APIs for integration consumption with a focus on contract-first design, versioning strategy, and backward compatibility. Implement policies for security, throttling, validation, and observability enable consistent API governance across teams. Support API testing and lifecycle automation through robust test harnesses and environment promotion practices. 5) Testing, Debugging & Quality Engineering Create integration test strategies covering contract tests, schema validation, payload regression, replay testing, and negative scenarios. Use API testing tools and structured logs/traces to debug and resolve integration defects across layers (connectivity, mapping, runtime, downstream dependencies). Maintain technical documentation (specs, mappings, test cases, runbooks) as part of delivery and handover. 6) Monitoring, Operations & Reliability Monitor interfaces, queues, and runtime health implement alerting and dashboards aligned to SLAs and operational KPIs. Build failure-mode handling (retries, reprocessing, dead-letter/error queues, idempotency patterns) to reduce incident frequency and mean-time-to-recover. Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive fixes to improve stability over time. 7) AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer) Build integration agents that can: o Draft interface specifications and mapping proposals from requirements and standards. o Generate initial mapping logic and routing templates, then validate against enterprise patterns. o Recommend remediation steps grounded in runbooks, prior incidents, and observed runtime signals. Implement retrieval-grounded assistance for integration engineering (interface catalogs, mapping rules, known errors, operational runbooks) so outputs stay verifiable and consistent. Establish evaluation loops (offline golden tests + online monitoring) to measure accuracy of AI-generated mappings, recommendations, and troubleshooting outputs. Enforce guardrails: tool permissions, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-impact changes, and strict handling of sensitive data. 8) Modernization & Transition Enablement Support modernization from legacy or tightly-coupled integrations toward API-led and cloud-ready patterns while keeping business continuity. Refactor legacy mappings (e.g., complex Java mappings) into maintainable equivalents where required, improving performance and operability. Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have) Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PO/PI integration development: repository/configuration artifacts, interface design, mappings, and runtime troubleshooting. Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns: routing, transformation, correlation, retries, idempotency, and error handling. Experience with a broad range of adapters/connectivity patterns and secure transport practices. API engineering fundamentals: contract-first design, versioning, security policies, observability, and testing. AI-native build capability: tool-augmented workflows, retrieval-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries. Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills Java-based mapping development and advanced transformation techniques (including XSLT where applicable). Exposure to hybrid integration landscapes and migration from legacy integration styles to modern API-led approaches. Strong documentation and operational readiness practices (runbooks, knowledge base, incident patterns). Familiarity with cloud integration concepts to support coexistence and transition strategies. What This Role Does Not Center On Training or fine-tuning foundation models from scratch. AI-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration lifecycle (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability). Value Delivered Faster delivery of integrations and APIs through intelligent generation of specs/mappings/templates and grounded troubleshooting. Improved reliability through robust testing, observability, and AI-augmented incident response with strict governance. Scalable integration modernization by evolving PO/PI estates toward API-led, reusable, and maintainable integration products. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education

Job Description Role Overview The Research Engineer – Generative AI and Computer Vision focuses on advancing state-of-the-art Generative AI and deep learning methods for real-world computer vision applications. The role combines applied research, experimentation, and engineering to develop robust AI solutions for image understanding, synthetic data generation, visual inspection, and continuous model monitoring. The role will contribute to applied research and development of scalable AI capabilities spanning the full computer vision lifecycle—from data preparation and model development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The work will address practical challenges such as limited or imbalanced training data, rare events, changing image conditions, data drift, and model-performance degradation in operation. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced AI research and real-world deployment, translating novel Generative AI and computer vision methods into reliable and scalable solutions across a range of industrial and business applications. Roles & Responsibilities : Generative AI and Synthetic Data: Research, design, and implement Generative AI approaches for creating realistic and diverse synthetic image datasets. Explore diffusion models, generative adversarial networks, image-to-image generation, controllable generation, and related techniques to address limited data, rare defects, class imbalance, and long-tail inspection scenarios. Computer Vision Model Development: Develop and evaluate deep learning models for industrial image inspection tasks such as image classification, defect detection, anomaly detection, object detection, segmentation, and representation learning. Work with CNN-based, transformer-based, and multimodal architectures. Data-Efficient Learning: Investigate methods including transfer learning, self-supervised learning, few-shot learning, domain adaptation, active learning, and synthetic data augmentation to reduce annotation effort and improve model performance under limited-data conditions. Model Monitoring and Robustness: Develop methods for continuously monitoring deployed inspection models and image-data pipelines. This includes detecting data drift, changes in image conditions, model-performance degradation, confidence shifts, unusual defect patterns, and out-of-distribution inputs. Research and Experimentation: Formulate research hypotheses, design controlled experiments and ablation studies, establish appropriate evaluation benchmarks, and analyze results with scientific rigor. Compare state-of-the-art methods and identify approaches suitable for industrial deployment. Prototype and Product Integration: Build proof-of-concept solutions and research prototypes using Python and modern deep learning frameworks. Collaborate with software, cloud, MLOps, manufacturing, and domain teams to integrate validated methods into scalable AI platforms and applications. Scalable AI Lifecycle: Contribute to capabilities covering data preparation, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement across the complete computer vision model lifecycle. jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Engineer, Machine Learning Engineering’ for Operational Intelligence Program, within B&MI group. This role will lead ML engineering team to execute on AI/ML strategy for the program that enables business growth, enhances customer experience, and ensures delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing software solutions. As a technology leader, this role will also focus on engineering best practices, next gen innovation and stakeholder management, while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within the team. Roles and Responsibilities: Implement multi-agent intelligence frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) to enable reasoning, coordination, and adaptive decision-making across specialized AI agents. Design and operationalize multi-modal AI pipelines combining text, image, tabular, and graph data using transformer-based architectures (BERT, CLIP, LLaVA, T5, Whisper, etc.) for unified intelligence. Build scalable RAG and Graph-RAG systems integrating vector stores and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) to enable contextual retrieval, semantic linking, and entity-aware reasoning. Develop and productionize transformer-based models for NLP, vision-language understanding, and sequential prediction tasks leveraging Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow ecosystems. Implement advanced Python-based backend services for inference orchestration, async job handling, and distributed data workflows supporting high-throughput AI operations. Establish end-to-end LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS) integrating MLflow, feature stores, model lineage, prompt evaluation, and continuous retraining frameworks. Apply traditional AI/ML and statistical modeling techniques (regression, clustering, forecasting, ensemble methods) alongside deep learning models for hybrid interpretability and explainability. Engineer state and memory management subsystems that preserve context, track embeddings, and enable agents to reason temporally across multiple modalities and interactions. Implement Responsible AI practices—bias detection, explainability dashboards, data ethics checks, and performance governance ensuring fairness and transparency of deployed models. Continuously research, benchmark, and productionize innovations in multimodal transformers, generative modeling, and agentic orchestration to drive enterprise-scale intelligence and automation. All About You: Master’s/bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering, and a considerable work experience with a proven track-record of successfully leading and managing complex projects/products and delivering to aggressive market needs. Expert-level hands on experience designing, building and deploying both conventional AI/ML solutions and LLM/Agentic solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems. Strong applied knowledge and hands on experience in advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning algorithms, GenAI and deep learning frameworks. Experience with AI and machine learning platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar. Strong programming skills in languages such as Python/SQL is a must. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of cloud computing services (AWS, Azure, GCP) related to data processing and storage is a plus. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Use these insights to tune prompts, tools, and workflows. ML Systems Engineering: Research, operationalize, and standardize ML tooling and processes, including installation, maintenance, documentation, and best practices. Generative & Agentic AI Architecture Knowhow: Comprehensive knowledge and working experience (preferred) of setting up an Agentic ecosystem with a hyperscaler like Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services(AWS). Platform Optimization & Lifecycle Management: Conduct ongoing optimization, performance tuning, and lifecycle management of agentic platforms and their underlying capabilities, including bug fixes, security patches, and capacity planning. Drive Agile Agentic POCs: Strong working knowledge and experience to develop & lead solution prototypes from ideation, scoping, implementation, and future road mapping with internal and vendor led teams. Drive agile POC execution with focus on hands-on capability validation on new emerging tools and platforms. Expert-Level Troubleshooting & Support: Provide advanced technical support and expert-level troubleshooting for complex issues related to agentic platform functionality, integrations, and performance, performing root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures. Technical Documentation Excellence: Create and maintain comprehensive, high-quality technical documentation for platform architecture, custom connectors, API specifications, operational procedures to ensure knowledge transfer and system maintainability. Governance & Best Practices: Help develop, collaborate, and establish Governance best practices, enterprise standards for Agentic tooling & new agentic solutions. Security & Compliance: Ensure all platform development and integrations adhere to enterprise security policies, data privacy regulations, and compliance standards. Embrace learning mindset: Continually invest in your own knowledge and skillset through formal training, reading, and attending conferences and meetups. Minimum of 1-2 years of hands-on, in-depth experience specifically with Generative AI (Gen AI) and Agentic AI technologies, platforms, and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Glean, etc.). Proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying complex integrations and custom connectors for enterprise-level applications. Technical Skills: Expert-level proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) with a strong emphasis on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Deep understanding and extensive experience with API design principles, development, and rigorous testing (RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC). Demonstrated expertise in building custom connectors and integrating diverse systems, including enterprise applications (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow) and various data sources. Good understanding/Working experience of agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent systems, and techniques for managing complex agent interactions and decision flows. Extensive experience with major cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform is preferred) and their AI/ML services (Vertex AI is preferred). Proficiency in establishing and utilizing monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog, Splunk) to ensure platform health and performance. Working knowledge of MCP connections, RAG, Vectors, Embeddings and Indexing, Knowledge graph and Oauth Flows. Strong understanding of CI/CD. Strong understanding of orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, Kubeflow etc. Soft Skills: Exceptional problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with a keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving complex technical challenges. Superior communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, working both independently and as a key contributor within cross-functional teams. Passion for learning new technologies and solving challenging problems. Ability to mentor others and lead the team in technology and best practices. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Understanding of the Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. Familiarity with AI/ML lifecycle stages and MLOps concepts. Background in building, maintaining, and supporting traditional ML pipelines in a GCP environment. Strong understanding and practical experience with MLOps principles and practices, including CI/CD for AI/ML workflows, model versioning, and deployment strategies. Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration platforms. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) is a plus. Ability to collaborate cross functional teams and provide tech mentorship to other stakeholders. Strong leadership potential with the ability to mentor junior engineers and drive best practices. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB).
