jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior AI Engineer Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to Roles & Responsibilities Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions. Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs. Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations. Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions. Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale. Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production. Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune). Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring. Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models. Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists. Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards. Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements. Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program. All About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability. Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably. Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency. Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models. A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains. Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome). Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value. Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents. Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability. Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock. Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems. The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations. The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations. As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises. Key job responsibilities Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises. Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches. Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices. Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders. Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software. Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions. Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology. Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description: About the Role: GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders at the front of the delivery pipeline — embedded with business unit teams, prototyping AI ideas at a days-to-weeks cadence and handing proven solutions off cleanly for scale-up. The Engineer-I is a mid-level individual contributor in the FDE team. This role contributes to FDE engagements under the direction of more senior FDEs, learning the practice through hands-on work. Most prototyping is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine code, and learning to use them fluently is part of the role. The FDE does not carry use cases to long-term operations — clean handoff is part of the job. Why This Role Exists: Enterprise AI needs engineers who can contribute to embedded prototype work alongside domain experts. The role builds the pipeline of senior FDE capability the function needs as its portfolio grows. Contributes to prototyping under the direction of Lead and Senior FDEs — shipping working AI proofs of concept with BU teams. Builds AI-native fluency using AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows as the default mode of work. Learns the FDE practice from more senior team members through hands-on engagements and direct mentorship. Key Responsibilities: FDE Engagement Contribution Contribute to BU use case engagements — prototyping, demoing, refining — under the direction of more senior FDEs. Embed with BU teams alongside the Lead or Senior FDE, building working relationships with BU engineers and product owners. AI-Native Engineering Operate AI agent workflows under guidance — contributing to multi-agent prototype delivery. Use AI coding assistants as the default mode of building; develop genuine fluency with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Databricks AI Assistant. Delivery & Handoff Contribute to clean handoff packages for the Solutions Engineer — documentation, runbooks, and working software. Apply existing patterns from the FDE pattern library; contribute small refinements to patterns as experience develops. Governance & Learning Support Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report conversations during prototyping alongside more senior FDEs. Actively learn the FDE practice from more senior team members; seek feedback and apply it rapidly. Required Experience At least 5+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software. Working proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar. Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and prompt engineering. Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development. Preferred Experience: Customer-facing engineering work — startup, lab, or innovation-team background. Familiarity with regulated industry constraints. Contribution to reusable engineering patterns in a previous team. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Skills AI Frameworks, Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning Algorithms, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation Why GSK? We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role We're after a hands-on engineer for our Forward Deployed team in Labs & CMC Digital & Tech, building the automation, data pipelines and AI tooling that take manual work out of the lab. You'll typically work closely alongside a Senior Principal Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer on the approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, while your own focus stays on turning that direction into working software: quickly, securely, and in a way that still holds up once it's live. As you build experience, you may take on more of that stakeholder relationship yourself, with support and guidance from leadership. Expect a lot of coding, pipeline work and cloud infrastructure, with security and testing built in as you go rather than bolted on at the end. Most weeks you'll be deep in one piece of the build: automating a lab workflow, wiring up a data pipeline, or getting an agentic prototype into decent shape, while staying close enough to the rest of the engagement to flag problems before they land on someone else's desk. As you get more experience, you'll be trusted with a bigger slice of the problem yourself, and eventually the whole thing. We care about software that scientists actually use. Less manual lab work, fewer errors, better data, medicines and vaccines moving faster through the pipeline. Why This Role Exists Labs & CMC is rebuilding how laboratory science and CMC work gets done, with automation, data and AI doing jobs scientists used to do by hand. Senior engineers typically lead and coordinate the relationship with the business side of that, working in close partnership with the wider team; this role exists to give them the extra hands to actually build what's agreed, while staying closely involved in how the work takes shape. You'll spend most of your time writing code, wiring up pipelines and getting things into production, picking up more ownership of the problem, and potentially of the stakeholder relationship itself, as you grow into the role and build a deeper understanding of what's needed. Turning direction into software: working with a Senior Forward Deployed DevSecOps Engineer to agree an approach, coordinating with stakeholders as needed, then building it properly rather than knocking together a demo. Keeping pace: most of what you'll build needs to land in days, not sprints, so you'll want to be comfortable shipping fast and adjusting as scientist feedback comes in. Automation that actually sticks: wiring up instruments, lab systems and data platforms so what you build is still running after the project wraps up. Getting the data right: pairing with data engineering so whatever you're building sits on data that's actually trustworthy. Production-ready by default: security, testing and monitoring go in as you build, not after something's already gone wrong. Leaving something behind: writing components and patterns that the next engineer, on this engagement or another one, can actually pick up and use. jobs.title: GenAI Platform Engineer – LLM Gateway
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY The GenAI Platform Engineering team builds and runs the shared platform that lets Pfizer colleagues and applications use generative AI safely and at scale. At its core is the enterprise GenAI Gateway: a single, governed entry point to large language models from multiple providers, with self-service access, routing, usage and cost transparency, and observability built in. Around it, we deliver evaluation, observability and agentic tooling — MCP integrations, agent registries and reusable agent skills — for teams across the company. We run the platform as a product: self-service over tickets, automation over manual approvals, small and frequent releases, and reliability we can measure. We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help evolve the Gateway and its ecosystem. You will keep it secure, fast and current in a fast-moving open-source landscape. You will work closely with a globally distributed team and with the teams that build on the platform. This is an individual contributor role. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Platform engineering Design, build and operate features of the enterprise LLM gateway, mainly in Python: multi-provider model access routing and failover API key and access management budgets, usage metering and chargeback Integrate agentic capabilities into the platform with the right security controls. Examples include Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool calling across providers, and agent-to-agent connectivity. Keep the platform’s open-source foundations current. Assess upstream releases, maintain and retire Pfizer-specific extensions, and deliver upgrades without regressions. Contribute to the platform’s admin and self-service experiences, including web UI, portals and developer documentation. Quality, reliability and security Build and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD. These include unit, integration, contract and performance/load tests that protect every release. Instrument services with metrics, traces and logs (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse). Use them to find and fix latency, error and cost issues. Take part in the support/on-call rotation. Lead root-cause analysis of production incidents, and turn the findings into lasting fixes and blameless postmortems. Apply secure-by-default engineering: identity and access controls (SSO, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, RBAC) secret handling dependency pinning and supply-chain hygiene Enablement and collaboration Evaluate emerging GenAI capabilities hands-on, such as model routing, guardrails and agent registries. Turn the results into clear recommendations on whether to adopt them. Help consuming teams onboard and succeed. Write guides and runbooks, and create reusable assets such as code samples and AI agent skills. Work in the open. Make InnerSource contributions, review code, and engage with open-source communities and vendors by reporting issues and proposing fixes upstream. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building GenAI/LLM-based applications or platforms used in production. Strong Python skills for backend services: async programming, FastAPI or similar, REST APIs and streaming responses. Hands-on experience with LLM provider APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), including tool/function calling and integrating multiple providers. Experience delivering and running services on AWS with containers and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Docker, GitHub Actions), with automated testing built into the workflow. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis. Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with distributed, cross-functional teams. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with an AI/LLM gateway or API gateway, including routing, key management and cost tracking. Experience running and extending open-source software in production, including patches, upgrades, regression testing and upstream contributions. Knowledge of agentic AI patterns and tooling: MCP LangGraph/LangChain or similar frameworks multi-agent orchestration RAG and vector search Experience with performance/load testing and observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Prometheus/Grafana). Experience with Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Frontend skills (React, TypeScript) for internal tools and portals. Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) and interest in building reusable agent skills. Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated environments. Experience mentoring engineers or delivering technical enablement, such as workshops, documentation and onboarding. AWS certification. WORK SCHEDULE Regular collaboration with colleagues in European time zones. Participation in the team’s support rotation. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Information & Business Tech

jobs.title: Gen AI - Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Generative AI Engineer Lead to drive the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI orchestration frameworks, cloud-native AI architectures, and model evaluation methodologies. This role will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI initiatives, from translating business requirements into AI-powered prototypes to delivering scalable, production-ready solutions across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake ecosystems. The candidate will also establish engineering best practices around prompt governance, model guardrails, benchmarking, and performance optimization. Responsibilities: Generative AI Solution Design Architect and implement enterprise-scale GenAI solutions using LLMs, foundation models, and agentic AI frameworks. Design reusable AI patterns, accelerators, and reference architectures to enable rapid solution development. Translate business problems into scalable AI workflows and production-ready proof-of-concepts. Drive AI platform modernization through adoption of emerging GenAI technologies and best practices. Prompt Engineering & LLM Governance Develop and maintain sophisticated prompt engineering frameworks for controlled and reliable LLM outputs. Implement prompt versioning, prompt lifecycle management, and testing strategies. Design AI guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, bias, security risks, and compliance concerns. Establish best practices for prompt optimization, response consistency, and output quality management. AI Workflow Orchestration & Automation Design and build scalable orchestration pipelines using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent. Develop reusable AI components, tools, agents, and workflow templates for enterprise adoption. Implement multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows to support complex business use cases. Prototyping & Business Enablement Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities. Rapidly develop AI prototypes and MVP solutions using synthetic and enterprise datasets. Convert prototypes into production-ready applications adhering to scalability, security, and reliability standards. Cloud & Data Engineering Build scalable GenAI architectures across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake platforms. Leverage cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex AI, and related ecosystems. Design robust RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures incorporating vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. Optimize model deployment, inference performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency. Evaluation & Performance Optimization Establish AI evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, latency, safety, and business impact. Develop benchmarking methodologies for comparing prompts, models, and workflows. Define KPIs, observability frameworks, and monitoring strategies for GenAI applications. Continuously improve model performance through prompt tuning, retrieval optimization, and workflow enhancements. Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, data engineering, or AI solution development. 4+ years of hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and foundation models. Strong experience designing enterprise GenAI solutions utilizing advanced LLM architectures and prompt frameworks. Expertise in building scalable AI workflows, orchestration pipelines, and reusable AI components. Proven ability to translate business requirements into production-ready AI solutions and prototypes using synthetic data. Deep understanding of prompt versioning, prompt governance, guardrails, and controlled LLM outputs. Hands-on experience with GCP, and Snowflake AI ecosystems. Strong knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, benchmarking methodologies, and optimization techniques. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG architectures. Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks.

jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly. The Mission Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI. This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions. What We're Looking For Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models Track record of building scalable ML systems Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us. Key job responsibilities The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As an Applied Scientist-II, you'll be a key contributor to end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—developing and refining algorithms that detect and eliminate false information, building models that identify vulnerabilities exploited by bad actors, and training systems that understand human values across diverse cultures. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily. But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. Every model you build and every experiment you run—from consensus-driven reasoning modules to orchestration components—will directly strengthen trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale. But here's what makes this role truly special: you'll shape the future. You'll lead efforts to identify, define, and mitigate risks early—protecting customers before they're impacted—and mentor the next generation of AI safety experts. You'll design multi-agent architectures where distributed AI systems exhibit emergent collective intelligence while maintaining human oversight and control. Every innovation you drive—from consensus-driven reasoning frameworks to sophisticated orchestration patterns—will set new standards for trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale. A day in the life As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values. About the team Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly. The Mission Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale. What You'll Build You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations. Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI. This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions. What We're Looking For Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models Track record of building scalable ML systems Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us. Key job responsibilities The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As an Applied Scientist-II, you'll be a key contributor to end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—developing and refining algorithms that detect and eliminate false information, building models that identify vulnerabilities exploited by bad actors, and training systems that understand human values across diverse cultures. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily. But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll contribute to identifying, defining, and mitigating AI safety risks early—helping protect customers before they're impacted—while building deep expertise in responsible AI. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. Every model you build and every experiment you run—from consensus-driven reasoning modules to orchestration components—will directly strengthen trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale. A day in the life As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values. About the team Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI. The term “sensitive content” includes within its scope a wide range of categories of content such as offensive content (e.g., hate speech, racist speech), profanity, content that is suitable only for certain age groups, politically polarizing content, and religiously polarizing content. The term “content” refers to any material that is exposed to customers by Alexa (including both 1P and 3P experiences) and includes text, speech, audio, and video. jobs.title: Principal - AI ML and Cloud Security
jobs.description: GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Domain focus: AI Engineering (agentic framework build and AI solution engineering); hands-on engineering of complex AI solutions in production, building reusable components, libraries and patterns for agent and platform workstreams. Job Purpose: The deepest hands-on engineering role in AI Engineering. You personally build the most complex AI solutions Cyber Architecture and Solutions delivers, lead the hardest engineering problems in the agentic framework, and develop the reusable components the rest of the team builds on. About the team : AI ML and Cloud Security is the function through which GSK is transforming security itself. The team designs and builds the agentic framework, a multi-agent platform moving security services across the Chief Security Office from rule-based to AI-driven operation. It owns AI architecture and AI engineering end to end: the agent layer, LLM orchestration, the AI and ML platform, and the data fabric pipeline that Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs, builds and tests before a managed service vendor operates it. The team also governs AI tool security posture, advises on cloud security across the Azure and GCP estate, and is the front door between GSK's business units and R&D and the technical AI function. AI security standards set here are binding on every AI initiative in GSK. Seventeen roles across the UK, India and the US. What makes this role different. A build role for someone who writes production code every day and wants to keep doing so. Expect a technical interview covering LangChain or LlamaIndex, vector database selection and retrieval tuning, and how you would test an agent whose output is non-deterministic. Tutorial or proof-of-concept exposure will not be enough — we are looking for things you shipped and then maintained. There is no line management in this role, by design. Key responsibilities: This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: Personally build the most complex AI solutions Cyber Architecture and Solutions delivers, using LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases and production Python. Build the shared SDK, evaluation harness and reusable components the agent and platform workstreams both depend on. Lead the hardest engineering problems in the agentic framework build. Develop reusable engineering components, libraries and patterns the wider team builds on. Build to the architecture specification and raise design problems early rather than engineering around them. Write tests and documentation to vendor handover standard. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and engineering tooling for AI workloads. Integrate agents with Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike and ServiceNow — writing and maintaining the connectors, not specifying them. Mentor engineers and review their code properly. Bring one toolchain change a quarter to the team with a working spike and a migration cost, not a recommendation. Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. Design components and APIs within the solutions you build, and document the trade-offs behind each design decision so the rationale survives handover. Apply GxP and data integrity expectations where what you build touches validated systems. Basic Qualifications: 10+ years in AI or software engineering with a relevant technical degree — domain focus: AI Engineering (agentic framework build and AI solution engineering); hands-on engineering of complex AI solutions in production, building reusable components, libraries and patterns for agent and platform workstreams Agent build in production Python and Kubernetes — LLM integration, prompt-to-action engineering, LangChain or LlamaIndex orchestration, tool and function calling, and evaluation of non-deterministic output RAG pipeline engineering end to end — chunking and embedding strategy, vector database and index design, retrieval tuning and evaluation, hallucination and grounding checks LLM application security in code — direct and indirect prompt injection defences, output validation, secrets handling, tool-call allow-listing and audit logging Delivering to architecture specification with tests and documentation to vendor-handover standard — raising design problems back to architecture rather than engineering around them, and mentoring analysts Preferred Qualifications: CI/CD pipelines for AI and ML platforms LLM evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval or equivalent), fine-tuning and prompt optimisation AI red-teaming tools such as Garak or PyRIT Cloud platform engineering on Azure or GCP Code review of junior engineers' work Typical tools and technologies: Production Python and Kubernetes, LangChain, LangGraph and LlamaIndex orchestration, vector databases and retrieval tuning across pgvector, Pinecone and Weaviate, model gateways such as LiteLLM, evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic output, reusable library and SDK design, CI/CD and automated testing. Skills AI for Cybersecurity, AI Safety Engineering, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence Techniques, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, LangChain (FrameWork), LlamaIndex, LLM Evaluation, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. jobs.title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. Key job responsibilities Design, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations. Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials. Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide. Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them. Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners. Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. A day in the life Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Software Engineer’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence Program, within B&MI group, to design scalable architecture and lead development of the new business requirements for product used by global B2B customers. Role and Responsibility As a Lead SDE you will design, develop and lead full-stack Java scalable applications with React or Angular as the frontend. Act as senior most engineers in the team to determine everything from design choices to technical standards, such as platforms and coding standards. Design and implement software aligned with Mastercard’s Enterprise Architecture and services. Write high-quality, maintainable code that meets business needs and adheres to timelines. Collaborate with cross functional teams - Product teams to understand the requirements, define product, identify solution, propose ideas and provide technical thought leadership. Provide detailed cost and time estimates, define technical scope and requirements, and assist project managers in managing scope throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure system design supports zero downtime in production. Address operational and business concerns to ensure consistent delivery of quality services. Lead highly focused team of engineers with an eye on innovation and AI adoption -All About You- Education and professional experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple organizational levels. Around 9 years of work experience in the software engineering role. Technical Expertise Strong proficiency in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and modern database technologies including Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch. Proven experience designing, developing, and leading applications built on microservices-based architectures. Hands-on experience with messaging and event-driven platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or other cloud-native messaging solutions. Front-end development experience using React JS (16+) or Angular (14+). Experience designing and developing APIs using OpenAPI specifications and RESTful best practices. Strong working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, Node.js, UNIX shell scripting, Python, and Groovy scripting. Understanding of modern application security, scalability, resiliency, and performance engineering practices. Tools & Methodologies Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle. Experience with automation and configuration management tools including Chef and Ansible. Hands-on experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile software development methodologies. Strong understanding of release management practices including Canary, Blue-Green, and Rolling deployments. Infrastructure & Cloud Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native application development. Strong expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. Deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies, and operational excellence in cloud environments. Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and related logging platforms. AI & Emerging Technologies Exposure to Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based solutions, including integrating AI services through APIs and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and enterprise AI platforms. Familiarity with AI-driven application patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent workflows, agentic solutions, and prompt engineering concepts for enterprise applications. Good to have Skills Experience working across multiple programming languages such as Java, Scala, C#, and Python. Familiarity with workflow orchestration and automation platforms including Netflix Conductor, Apache Airflow, Camunda, and N8N. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing concepts. Familiarity with business rules engines such as Drools and EasyRules. Strong understanding of cryptographic concepts including PKI infrastructure, hashing, encryption, consensus algorithms, and virtual machine architectures. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation frameworks. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale. We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization. As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations. You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners. Key job responsibilities Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base. Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions. Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices. Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability. About the team The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. jobs.title: Vice President, AI Data Scientist, Private Markets
jobs.description: Locations: Bengaluru, India Job description About this role VP – AI/ML - Private Markets Forward-deployed AI leadership for connected private-markets intelligence Build AI systems that connect fragmented evidence, reason across complex entity networks and turn trusted private-markets data into scalable research and decision intelligence. Your team You will join a forward-deployed, multidisciplinary AI and data science team working at the intersection of advanced AI, knowledge engineering, private-markets research and enterprise product delivery. We partner directly with researchers, data specialists, product leaders and engineers to solve high-value problems across funds, investors, fund managers, companies, deals, service providers and the relationships that connect them. Our focus is to transform fragmented public, contributed and derived information into trusted, connected and decision-ready intelligence. We combine domain expertise, strong data foundations, human judgment and rigorous engineering to build capabilities that can be reused across data acquisition, research, validation, enrichment and data management. You will work in an environment where applied research is expected to become dependable production capability, and where quality, provenance, security and responsible human oversight are designed in from the start. Your role & impact As Vice President, AI Data Scientist, you will be a senior player-coach and technical owner for a portfolio of graph-enabled AI capabilities. You will work directly with users to identify consequential problems, test the right technical approach and lead delivery from discovery through governed production and adoption. Your core mandate is to research, build and scale enterprise-grade multi-agent LLM systems, with particular depth in knowledge graphs, graph-enabled agent interactions and predictive modelling across connected entity networks. You will determine when graph reasoning, retrieval, machine learning, agentic orchestration or deterministic services best fit the problem, rather than defaulting to complexity. Your impact will be visible in stronger data coverage and quality, faster and more effective research, better relationship intelligence, scalable automation and new insights that help BlackRock Preqin remain at the forefront of private-markets data and technology. You will also raise the technical bar by developing people, codifying reusable patterns and translating research advances into practical enterprise capability. Your responsibilities Own the technical vision and delivery roadmap for graph-enabled AI and applied data science across private-markets data acquisition, research and data-management workflows. Work forward-deployed with researchers, data specialists and product teams to frame ambiguous problems, define measurable outcomes and iterate rapidly from evidence to production. Architect and deliver advanced LLM and multi-agent workflows that can plan, retrieve, traverse graphs, use tools, reason across evidence, verify conclusions and produce source-grounded outputs. Define how agents interact with knowledge graphs, vector and relational stores, document evidence, search services and approved external sources, with clear controls for access, state, memory and tool use. Build and evolve enterprise knowledge-graph capabilities, including domain modelling, entity resolution, relationship discovery, graph quality, provenance, temporal context and integration with operational data products. Develop graph-based retrieval and context-assembly methods that improve factual grounding, entity disambiguation and multi-step reasoning across complex private-markets relationships. Design predictive and probabilistic models over entity networks to identify patterns, prioritise investigation and surface potential relationships, while clearly separating obs erved facts from modelled signals. Lead applied research and experimentation across model adaptation, retrieval, graph machine learning, agent evaluation and reasoning, converting successful approaches into reusable production components. Establish evaluation as a core engineering discipline, using representative datasets, explicit quality standards, regression testing, human feedback, provenance, observability and monitored production outcomes. Own production quality across reliability, latency, cost, security and maintainability, and make pragmatic build, buy, partner and reuse decisions. Partner with engineering, product, risk, privacy, information security, legal and compliance colleagues to ensure appropriate governance, human oversight and accountable use of AI. Mentor data scientists and AI engineers, provide technical direction and design review, strengthen hiring and capability development, and communicate complex trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. Required experience We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who combines research depth, production judgment and customer-facing problem solving. You should bring: Substantial experience designing, building and operating production AI and machine-learning systems in an enterprise, SaaS, data-product or similarly complex environment. Demonstrated leadership of technically complex AI initiatives from problem discovery and experimentation through deployment, monitoring, adoption and measurable outcomes. Deep expertise in LLM applications and agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, planning, orchestration, memory or state management, structured outputs and evaluation of non-deterministic behavior. Strong practical experience with knowledge graphs and graph data science, including graph modelling, entity and relationship resolution, graph retrieval or traversal, reasoning over connected data and graph quality controls. Experience developing predictive models on relational or networked data, with disciplined treatment of uncertainty, explainability, bias, leakage and model validation. Strong grounding in modern machine learning, experimentation and software engineering, with the ability to write production-quality code and work effectively across data, model, service and application layers. Experience with unstructured and multimodal information, semantic retrieval, provenance and data-quality engineering in workflows where domain experts provide ground truth and structured feedback. A strong record of working directly with users or customers to translate ambiguous, high-value needs into usable products, and of converting domain-specific solutions into reusable capabilities. Sound judgment on architecture and model trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, security, maintainability and operational risk. Ability to lead through influence, mentor technical talent and communicate clearly with research, product, engineering and executive audiences. Understanding of private markets, alternative investments, financial data or adjacent institutional-investment workflows is highly desirable; curiosity and the ability to build domain depth quickly are essential. Commitment to responsible AI, data provenance, privacy, security and meaningful human control in high-trust enterprise workflows. Why this role This is an opportunity to shape how AI understands and connects the private-markets ecosystem, working with rich domain data, real researcher workflows and problems where trust matters. You will have meaningful ownership, direct access to users and the mandate to turn frontier methods into durable capabilities with enterprise reach. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. jobs.title: Program Manager II, Amazon Books
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Are you passionate about using technology, automation, and data to solve complex business problems at scale? The Books Risk Management (BRM) Automation team is seeking a Program Manager II to drive automation programs that improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and enhance the customer experience across Amazon's Books business. In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. You will lead high-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Key job responsibilities Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI-enabled solutions. Use data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and prioritize investments. Lead deep dives into operational issues, quality defects, and high-severity escalations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions. Monitor automation performance, adoption, accuracy, and business impact through scalable reporting mechanisms. Build business cases, define success metrics, and measure realized benefits including productivity gains, quality improvements, and operational leverage. Translate business requirements into actionable technical requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle. Drive end-to-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows. Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations. Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes. A day in the life You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact. About the team The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of program or project management experience 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience 3+ years of driving process improvements experience Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization Experience building processes, project management, and schedules Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Sr. Application Architect
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager. Key job responsibilities We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about: Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
