jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our Company: At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to play a key role in building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata’s cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. You will: Design and build key components of Teradata’s agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses : tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients , and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. Integrate and serve LLMs , both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata’s vector store. Contribute to technical design reviews and architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions for your area. Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best You’ll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley , working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. You’ll also work cross-functionally with: Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. Minimum Requirements BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps : deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). Experience implementing AI guardrails , red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. #LI-PG1 Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.title: Senior Development Lead - Advanced RPA
jobs.description: Job Summary Senior AWS Connect & CX AI Engineer Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on AWS Connect & CX AI Engineer to design, build, and maintain reusable customer experience demonstrations on AWS -Amazon Connect as the core contact center platform. This role combines Amazon Connect engineering, conversational AI, generative AI, backend integration, analytics, and demo development. The primary objective is to create client-ready solutions that can be rapidly configured for RFPs, pursuits, workshops, and industry-specific CX use cases. The ideal candidate can independently translate a business use case into a working AWS demonstration, explain the architecture to business and technical stakeholders, and document the solution for reuse by other team members. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Amazon Connect Administration & Omnichannel Configuration Configure and administer Amazon Connect instances, users, security profiles, queues, routing profiles, hours of operation, phone numbers, and agent workspace. Design and develop contact flows for inbound and outbound customer journeys. Configure voice and chat capabilities and integrate email, SMS, and WhatsApp use cases where supported by the selected architecture. Configure agent, supervisor, recording, monitoring, and reporting experiences. Set up and demonstrate Tasks, Cases, Customer Profiles, and outbound engagement capabilities where applicable. 2. Conversational AI & Customer Self-Service Develop Amazon Lex voice and chat bots using intents, slots, prompts, validation, fulfilment, and fallback logic. Build conversational IVR and self-service journeys for authentication, intent discovery, knowledge retrieval, transaction completion, confirmation, and escalation. Design controlled handoff from bots to human agents with relevant customer and interaction context. Create reusable conversational components, prompts, business rules, and industry-specific customer journeys. 3. Generative AI, Agent Assist & Agentic AI Configure Amazon Q in Connect for knowledge recommendations, contextual guidance, suggested responses, interaction summaries, and after-contact work. Develop generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, knowledge bases, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, guardrails, and validation controls. Build AI agents for customer self-service, agent assistance, workflow execution, and exception handling. Design MCP-enabled tools or equivalent service interfaces that allow AI agents to retrieve information and execute approved actions. Implement human-in-the-loop controls, confirmation steps, and traceability for agentic workflows. 4. AWS Integration & Development Develop backend business logic and integrations using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and CloudWatch. Integrate Amazon Connect journeys with mock or enterprise CRM, case management, order management, billing, appointment, and service management systems. Develop secure REST API and event-driven integration patterns with appropriate IAM and access controls. Use Python for backend development and automation; working knowledge of Node.js or TypeScript is preferred. Apply source control, deployment, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting practices across demo assets. 5. Conversation Analytics & Quality Monitoring Configure Contact Lens for transcription, conversation analytics, sentiment analysis, contact themes, keyword detection, and interaction search. Build demonstrations for automated quality evaluation, compliance checks, contact-driver analysis, interaction summaries, and supervisor insights. Create dashboards and outputs that explain self-service completion, transfer reasons, customer themes, and operational opportunities. Validate analytics outputs and clearly document assumptions, limitations, and data dependencies. 6. Demo Factory Development & Presales Support Build reusable AWS CX demo environments and accelerators that can be configured for retail, banking, utilities, healthcare, telecom, education, and other industries. Develop end-to-end demonstrations covering self-service, human handoff, agent assist, workflow completion, conversation analytics, and reporting. Partner with CX transformation, solution, engineering, sales, and presales teams to convert client requirements into credible demonstrations. Create demo scripts, architecture diagrams, sample data, configuration guides, deployment documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. Support RFP responses, client workshops, technical walkthroughs, and live demonstrations. Document security considerations, production dependencies, known limitations, and assumptions without overstating demo readiness. 7. Engineering Ownership & Reusability Own the design, build, test Skill Requirements Required Qualifications 4–18 years of overall experience in cloud application development, contact center technology, conversational AI, or related engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience administering and developing solutions on Amazon Connect. Practical experience building voice and chat bots using Amazon Lex. Experience with Amazon Q in Connect and Contact Lens, including agent assistance, knowledge recommendations, analytics, or quality use cases. Hands-on AWS development experience using Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, and REST APIs. Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, knowledge bases, guardrails, and AI agent patterns. Strong Python development capability; exposure to Node.js or TypeScript is preferred. Experience integrating contact center solutions with CRM, case management, order, billing, or service platforms. Ability to independently design, build, test, demonstrate, document, and troubleshoot an end-to-end solution. Good understanding of contact center operations, customer journeys, routing, quality monitoring, and operational reporting. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Must Have Skill Advanced RPA - Agentic AI,Architecture design,Verbal Communication,Written Communication,Interpersonal Effectiveness Good to Have Skill Amazon Web Services (AWS) Other Requirements Preferred Qualifications Experience building reusable demo environments, proof-of-concepts, solution accelerators, or presales prototypes. Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, or similar agent integration patterns. Experience with Amazon Connect Customer Profiles, Cases, Tasks, outbound campaigns, and related workforce or quality capabilities. Knowledge of OpenSearch, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or Terraform. Integration experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms. Relevant AWS certifications in Solutions Architecture, Development, Machine Learning, or related areas. Experience supporting client workshops, technical presentations, RFPs, and live demonstrations. Behavioural Competencies Strong hands-on ownership and delivery orientation Structured problem-solving and solution design capability Ability to operate independently in an evolving presales environment Clear communication with business and technical stakeholders Ability to convert requirements into practical and demonstrable customer journeys Strong collaboration across transformation, sales, architecture, and engineering teams Focus on reusability, documentation, reliability, and technical credibility

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. JOB OVERVIEW General Mills, Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Sr Data Scientist to join the Data Science team. Data Scientists within our team are dedicated to build enterprise intelligent automations and enable Core ML, Deep Learning, Generative AI solutions on various use cases in CPG. They are also responsible for curating a community of practice to determine the best standards and practices around data science at General Mills. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Lead the design and delivery of scalable data science solutions that solve high-value business problems across Core ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. Partner with business stakeholders to frame problems, translate needs into measurable outcomes, and communicate insights and recommendations clearly. Develop and evaluate ML models across regression, classification, forecasting, optimization, NLP, and deep learning, apply robust experimentation, evaluation, and error-analysis practices. Design and implement Agentic AI, LLM, NLP, and RAG solutions, including data curation, ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval optimization, fine-tuning, and human-in-the-loop evaluation. Define and maintain business semantics, including ontologies, taxonomies, and metadata, to enable consistent retrieval and reasoning across enterprise information. Collaborate with ML engineers and systems engineers to deploy, monitor, and improve production models, proactively address performance degradation and maintainability through MLOps practices. Champion Responsible AI by applying privacy, security, governance, transparency, and bias-reduction practices throughout solution design and delivery. Provide technical leadership through solution reviews, consultation, and constructively challenge other data scientist on the approach. Contribute to best practices as we evaluate new platforms, tools, and pipelines. Apply sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques for complex, diverse business problems. Build connections with senior internal and external experts to bring relevant perspectives into solution design. Build trusted stakeholder relationships, manage priorities and delivery commitments, and represent Data Science as a thought partner across functions. Mentor junior data scientists, interns, and contractors and support their technical and domain development. Stay current on industry trends, lead applied research aligned to business needs, and contribute to relevant open-source innovation. . MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 10-12 years of relevant analytics or data science experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering production ML and AI solutions. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science , Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline from a Tier 1 institute. Strong expertise in supervised machine learning, including regression, decision trees, ensemble methods, time series, forecasting, neural networks, and model performance tuning, exposure to unsupervised learning and NLP. Strong understanding of production ML practices, including MLOps, containerization, data lineage, model monitoring, and visualization. Proficiency in Python, SQL and Google Cloud Platform. Experience with Agile delivery practices, including sprints, estimation, and daily stand-ups. Strong stakeholder management, consulting, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences. Experience in the FMCG/CPG domain, supply chain analytics experience is preferred. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience in leading the design and implementation of complex end-to-end data science solutions using Generative AI, LLM, NLP, Agentic AI, or RAG from business problem framing and data curation through fine-tuning, evaluation, and production deployment. Strong understanding and experience in architecting high-quality Agentic AI and RAG workflows, including data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, and optimizing retrieval performance using established frameworks and vector stores. Expertise in hypothesis-driven experimentation, defining robust evaluation strategies, error taxonomies, and human-in-the-loop reviews. Hands-on experience with GenAI tooling such as Vertex AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, embeddings, or vector databases. E xperience with deep learning, optimization, or operations research. Experience with GCP architecture and enterprise-scale AI solution design. Knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals and Responsible AI governance. ELIGIBILITY Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

jobs.description: DESCRIPTION At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and carry products that our customers want and enjoy, while ensuring that customers are safe and get safe products from Amazon. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, dynamic and driven people. If you'd like to help us build an environment where our customer's safety is paramount, where we enable our customers to find and buy anything online, and where we ensure that we maintain and enhance customer trust on Amazon, then this is your chance to be part of a challenging and strategic initiative. We're looking for a strong Senior Product Manager - Technical to join our team in Bangalore, India. This role requires exceptional technical depth in Generative AI, as you'll partner with Applied Scientists and Engineering teams to build next-generation AI-powered compliance and safety solutions. You should have strong technical problem-solving skills, product management expertise in AI/ML domains, excellent communication skills, and deep understanding of how to evaluate, deploy, and scale LLM-based systems in production environments. You should also possess the ability to influence people across the organization from tech leadership to business managers by creating win-win solutions, and the desire to be an individual contributor driving Amazon's next generation of AI-powered safety technology. This role will report into the global product team that enables Trustworthy shopping experience at Amazon and ensures Safety and Compliance across Amazon stores. A primary focus of this role is defining the product strategy and roadmap for GenAI applications that automate compliance workflows, enhance decision-making accuracy, and scale our safety operations globally. You will work closely with Applied Scientists to evaluate LLM capabilities, design human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems, and establish AI governance frameworks that ensure responsible deployment of AI models in high-stakes compliance scenarios. This role is inherently cross-functional—the professional will work closely with various partner teams across Amazon including Applied Science, Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Safety and Compliance to bring AI-powered products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing tech products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, technically sophisticated in AI/ML domains, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines while managing complex stakeholder alignment. You should be passionate about retail, supply chain, consumer business, and building meaningful AI-powered products that transform how Amazon ensures customer safety at scale. Prior experience working in product management for AI/ML products, managing GenAI roadmaps, and working in retail or supply chain environments is preferred. Key job responsibilities GenAI Product Strategy & Execution: Define and own the 3-5 year product vision and roadmap for GenAI-powered compliance automation, balancing innovation with operational excellence Partner with Applied Scientists and ML Engineers to evaluate LLM capabilities for safety and compliance workflows, including accuracy, latency, cost, and safety guardrails Design and launch human-in-the-loop (HITL) systems that combine AI automation with human judgment for high-stakes compliance decisions Establish metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI model performance, including precision/recall, false positive rates, cost per decision, and operational impact Assess emerging LLM technologies (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) and recommend strategic investments for Amazon's compliance tech stack Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Work with internal customers to understand their use cases, pain points, and requirements for AI-assisted compliance workflows Collaborate with partner engineering teams to drive product roadmaps for compliance and safety, ensuring technical excellence and scalability Challenge Science teams on model architecture decisions, technical trade-offs, and design choices to ensure optimal product outcomes Address bottlenecks, provide customer input, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints Understand and articulate the technical reasons behind product architecture decisions and recognize when technical design limits future innovation Cross-Functional Program Management: Partner with multiple tech, product, and operations teams across multiple locations with varying priorities to ensure timely delivery of AI solutions Clarify and drive project commitments as well as establish and maintain clear chains of accountability across Science, Engineering, and Operations Drive adoption of GenAI solutions across global compliance operations through change management, training, and stakeholder engagement Manage complex initiatives across numerous business models and create certainty out of ambiguity while maintaining firm grasp over operational, financial, and technical aspects Data-Driven Decision Making: Query and analyze data to derive insightful findings that inform product strategy and prioritization Define success metrics for AI model deployment including business impact, operational efficiency gains, and customer experience improvements Conduct cost-benefit analyses for GenAI investments, including model training costs, inference costs, and operational savings AI Governance & Responsible AI: Establish AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices for compliance use cases Design evaluation protocols for model safety, bias detection, and fairness in automated decision-making Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure AI solutions meet regulatory requirements and ethical standards BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product Experience managing technical products or online services Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools Our inclusive Our work involves building state-of-the-art data processing pipelines and Information Retrieval (IR) systems that handle diverse data streams and automatically create structured entities from unstructured/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large-scale distributed systems, streaming and batch processing technologies, Elastic Computing, Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and service-oriented architectures to tackle challenges at Amazon's global scale. jobs.description: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. jobs.description: Job Purpose : As Enterprise AI’s delivery portfolio grows and GenAI and agentic solutions move from pilot to production, the platform must scale reliably and safely. The AI Platform Engineer owns significant areas of that platform — ensuring they operate at SLO, building automation against routine operations work, embedding security and responsible AI controls into the platform layer, and contributing to the vendor and standards conversations that shape the platform’s direction. Owns significant platform areas with genuine accountability for reliability, security, performance, and cost efficiency of AI services — not just task execution. Makes AI consumable at enterprise scale by operating the gateways, model endpoints, and context services through which every team reaches models, tools, and data. Builds platform leverage through automation, self-service, and reusable components that reduce manual operations work across the team. Embeds governance by design so that AI security, data protection, and responsible AI controls are enforced by the platform rather than negotiated project by project. Develops the next generation by mentoring junior and mid-level platform engineers, building team capability over time. Responsibilities : At least 6 years of experience running SaaS, cloud, or platform-engineering services in a production setting, including at least 2 years operating AI/ML or GenAI workloads or services. Strong proficiency in Python; working proficiency in at least one additional language (for example, Go, TypeScript, or Java). Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform; Bicep a plus), GitOps, and modern CI/CD. Hands-on experience operating API gateways or AI/LLM gateways, including routing, rate limiting, authentication, and policy enforcement for AI traffic. Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic patterns — tool calling, orchestration, and agent frameworks — and of how context is retrieved, managed, and governed for LLM applications. Experience operating production services with defined SLOs, observability, and incident management. Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as a primary development mode. Solid understanding of identity and access management, secrets management, and data protection for cloud and AI services. Required skills: Platform & Cloud: Kubernetes, containers, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, DevSecOps, platform reliability engineering, and at least one major cloud (Azure preferred) with multi-cloud and hybrid architecture awareness. AI Gateway & API Management: API gateway patterns, AI/LLM gateway architecture and operations, traffic management, and policy enforcement. GenAI Operations: LLM deployment, versioning, and monitoring; prompt and evaluation workflows; RAG architectures; vector search fundamentals. MCP & Agents: Model Context Protocol, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and an understanding of agent orchestration frameworks and context engineering. Observability: Metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting (for example, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or cloud-native equivalents) applied to AI services. Security: IAM, OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, network security, and data privacy controls for AI workloads. Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Distributed Systems, or SRE is advantageous. Preferred skills: Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, Azure API Management), with AWS and GCP AI services (for example, Bedrock, Google Cloud AI platform) desired. Model serving and GPU infrastructure: inference runtimes (for example, vLLM, KServe, Triton), GPU scheduling, and autoscaling. Vector and retrieval stacks: vector databases and hybrid search (for example, pgvector, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, or dedicated vector stores). Agent and LLM frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, or comparable; agent interoperability protocols; evaluation tooling. Gateway technologies: Kong AI Gateway or comparable (for example, Envoy-based gateways, LiteLLM, Portkey, Azure API Management). Platform tooling: Databricks, policy-as-code (OPA/Kyverno), service mesh, internal developer platforms (for example, Backstage), and FinOps for AI (token economics and unit-cost reporting). We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Our services are part of nearly every interaction between PayPal and its customers and partners, powering risk decisioning, fraud detection, and risk management globally. We partner with data science and business teams for Machine Learning Engineering activities that involve feature development Model deployment. We are migrating our legacy model and feature platform to HelixOS, our next-generation Risk platform. Lead and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, driving alignment on requirements, timelines, and technical direction. Proven experience designing, building, and operating microservice architectures in production. Solid understanding of data structures, object-oriented design, distributed systems, and database fundamentals (SQL and NoSQL). Ability to write reliable, scalable, maintainable, secure, and performant code, with strong testing practices. Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead initiatives, influence technical decisions, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Develop scalable data models and extract, load, and transform (ELT) transformations, using advanced SQL to support complex workloads while optimizing performance, scalability, and cost. Develop and operate reliable directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing while implementing automated data-quality checks, reconciliation, lineage, alerting, monitoring, and failure handling. Build modular, maintainable, well-tested solutions and improve engineering productivity through reusable frameworks, automation, and responsibly governed artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted development. Partner with product teams, data specialists, and consumers to translate requirements into dependable solutions, taking end-to-end ownership and communicating progress, risks, and issues. Diagnose production issues and improve reliability, observability, and resilience while contributing to modernization and migration of existing data pipelines to BlackRock's enterprise data platform. Advanced SQL and strong hands-on Snowflake experience, including complex transformations, schema design, semi-structured data, ELT patterns, query troubleshooting, and performance and cost optimization. Practical experience developing and troubleshooting data workflows, combined with a strong understanding of data warehousing and modeling concepts, including dimensional and historical data design. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and production issues and take ownership in an agile, globally distributed environment. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Sheriff Team- Payroll tech
jobs.description: DESCRIPTION Payroll Tech's Sheriff team develops and maintains ML and Generative AI applications that support Payroll Operations and Amazon employees at scale. Our portfolio includes Pay-Input Anomaly Detection, which improves the pay experience by identifying pay input irregularities such as leaves and insurance discrepancies; Percept, which improves ticket resolution by providing intelligent ticket prioritization via sentiment scoring, ticket summarization, defect classification, and categorization; Penny, a Virtual Assistant that enables payroll operations teams to efficiently retrieve information from multiple sources including policies, Percept data, vendor data, and HR data via Xylem through a single browser interface; Pay Ticket Genie, in process of being integrated with Amazon AZA(A to Z Assistant); Niyam, our rule engine; and Policy as Code Extraction (PoCo), a critical component of SPACE (Single Payroll Autonomous and Computation Engine) Amazon's in-house payroll system built to eliminate third-party vendor dependency for payroll processing. PoCo ensures data accuracy by validating that pay instructions are correct and performing calculations when required. It consists of two components: policy-based rule creation, where business owners select a pay code and provide policy links to generate rules for specific business processes, and rule evaluation, where upstream services send real-time validation or calculation requests and receive results along with rationale for any failures. Sheriff team owns policy-based rule creation and powering the rule evaluation system with rules generated. As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that power these systems: driving model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across the payroll ecosystem. Key Job Responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will operate across three core dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence. Invent You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches as well as emerging technologies from the research community. You practice customer-obsessed science : working backwards from the needs of Amazon employees and payroll operations teams to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methodologies for anomaly detection, sentiment analysis, ticket classification, prescriptive analysis, intelligent virtual assistance, and automated policy extraction. You identify and define the research agenda for expanding Percept's capabilities including prescriptive analysis feature; lead the scientific strategy for the Penny-AZA integration enabling accurate and low-latency responses to Amazon employee payroll queries, and drive the ML strategy for Policy as Code extraction(PoCo), developing models that extract, interpret, and codify payroll policies into structured, executable rules that power real-time pay instruction validation and calculation within SPACE. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues that validate the novelty of your work, when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations. Implement The ML components you develop are directly integrated into production systems or directly support large-scale applications serving Amazon's global payroll operations. You make appropriate tradeoffs between model accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and immediate versus long-term solutions; favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the correct level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI frameworks largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with data sources including USC (Unified Central Service), Xylem, SIM-Ticketing, Pay Code Governance system, and PoCo's rule evaluation engine. Influence You contribute to tactical and strategic planning for the Sheriff team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for the global expansion of Percept, driving both feature growth and country-level launches own the complex AI track for Penny-AZA integration collaborating across partner teams including Reflect and GREF to ensure seamless data integration and robust ML pipeline workflows, and drive the scientific roadmap for PoCo's expansion to 100K US employees, ensuring the ML models powering policy extraction, rule generation and testing scale reliably to meet this growth. You mentor scientists and engineers on the team and across teams, championing best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) to rapidly increase developer productivity and delivery velocity. You provide peer feedback on research procedures and results within and across teams, help recruit and develop bar-raising talent through interview drives, and grow the team's organizational knowledge of Sheriff team ML solutions. You are visible in the broader internal and external scientific communities as a subject matter expert and regularly serve as a Program Committee (PC) member at peer-reviewed conferences or review articles for journal publications. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of building models for business application experience PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience using Unix/Linux Experience in professional software development Experience communicating research findings and analysis in both written and spoken channels Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Sr. Development Lead
jobs.description: Job Summary Role Title: Generative AI Engineer / Applied AI Developer Experience Required: Minimum 5+ Years in Software / Machine Learning (with 1.5+ years hands-on in LLMs & GenAI) Core Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector DBs, FastAPI, Docker, Cloud AI (AWS/Azure) Target Work Model: Hybrid (Enterprise Office / Remote flexibility available) Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Position We are seeking a talented, technically passionate Generative AI Engineer with 3+ years of professional software engineering and applied AI/ML experience to design, build, and deploy production-grade LLM applications. In this hands-on engineering role, you will turn the latest advancements in generative artificial intelligence into resilient, scalable business solutions. You will specialize in constructing Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, engineering autonomous agents with deterministic tool-calling capabilities, optimizing prompt workflows, experimenting with parameter-efficient model adaptation (LoRA/QLoRA), and serving high-performance inference APIs via containerized microservices hosted on AWS or Microsoft Azure. Key Responsibilities RAG Architecture & Vector Search Engineering RAG Pipeline Development: Design and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines incorporating multi-modal document parsing, recursive text splitting, and semantic chunking. Vector Store Management: Integrate, optimize, and benchmark vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search) for sub-second similarity search. Hybrid Search & Re-ranking: Implement hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings with sparse lexical keyword matching (BM25) and cross-encoder re-ranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE). Context Optimization: Engineer contextual compression, parent-document retrieval, and metadata filtering schemas to eliminate context noise and hallucinations. B. Agentic Workflows & Multi-Tool Integration Agentic Frameworks: Build stateful multi-agent workflows and autonomous task execution loops using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. Tool Calling & Action APIs: Develop robust, type-safe function-calling and tool-use interfaces connecting LLMs to external REST APIs, relational databases, and enterprise systems. Loop Safeguards & Routing: Implement plan-and-solve agent patterns, multi-step reflection loops, and fallback error-handling to prevent infinite agent recursion. C. Prompt Engineering, Output Validation & Fine-Tuning Prompt Engineering: Design and test systematic prompt templates utilizing Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Few-Shot prompting, ReAct patterns, and directional stimulus prompting. Structured Output Parsing: Enforce deterministic, validated output structures using Pydantic, Instructor, Guidance, or Outlines to guarantee reliable downstream ingestion. Model Adaptation: Conduct Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) on open-weights models (Llama 3, Mistral, Phi-3/4) for domain-specific tasks. D. Backend API & Inference Microservices Inference APIs (FastAPI): Develop high-throughput asynchronous backend microservices using Python (FastAPI), managing connection pooling, concurrency, and rate limiting. Streaming Latency: Implement low-latency streaming inference pipelines utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSockets for conversational user interfaces. Inference Engines: Optimize inference throughput utilizing modern serving engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama, minimizing Time-to-First-Token (TTFT). Containerized Deployment: Containerize applications with Docker and configure deployment manifests for Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS, or Azure Container Apps. E. Evaluation, Guardrails & LLMOps Observability Automated Model Evaluation: Establish automated evaluation benchmarks utilizing synthetic test datasets and evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) to quantify faithfulness and recall. AI Guardrails & Safety: Implement enterprise guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Azure Content Safety) to proactively mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, and toxicity. Observability & Tracing: Integrate comprehensive LLM tracing, prompt versioning, and cost monitoring using tools like Langfuse, Phoenix, or Weights & Biases. Skill Requirements Required Technical Skills & Qualifications Total Experience: Minimum 3+ years of professional software engineering / data science experience, with at least 1.5+ years of dedicated hands-on GenAI / LLM development. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or equivalent technical field. Python & ML Foundations: Advanced Python programming skills (asyncio, type hints, Pydantic, pytest) and deep familiarity with PyTorch or Hugging Face Transformers. GenAI Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and commercial/open foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock). Vector Search & RAG: Proven track record building and deploying production RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector). Backend & Containers: Hands-on proficiency developing asynchronous REST APIs using FastAPI, Docker containerization, and Git-based collaborative workflows. Core Competencies: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, solid understanding of transformer architecture mechanics, and proactive technical curiosity. 4. Preferred Qualifications & Industry Certifications Inference Optimization: Hands-on experience with model quantization (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) and high-throughput inference serving engines (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM). Cloud Certifications: Cloud AI certifications: AWS Certified AI Practitioner / ML Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or Azure AI Fundamentals. Open Source & Portfolio: Demonstrated contributions to open-source GenAI projects, LangChain/LlamaIndex community plugins, or active technical blog/GitHub repository. Agile Collaboration: Experience working in Agile/Scrum sprint environments collaborating with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Frontend Developers. Must Have Skill Advanced Business Analysis - Gen AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements . Candidate Evaluation Matrix (For Technical Interview Panels) Technical interviewers should evaluate candidates across the following five core technical engineering competencies: Evaluation Area Competency Focus Key Technical Signals RAG Architecture & Retrieval Chunking strategies, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and re-ranking Explains concrete trade-offs between chunk sizes; demonstrates practical experience with hybrid search (BM25 + vector) and cross-encoders to improve recall. Agentic Loops & Tool Calling Function calling, stateful graphs, and error recovery mechanisms Can code and debug an agent with deterministic tool use; understands state management in LangGraph; handles schema parsing errors gracefully. Prompt Engineering & Parsing Few-shot prompting, structured JSON schema validation (Pydantic) Demonstrates advanced prompting techniques (ReAct, CoT); knows how to force LLMs to emit valid JSON schemas reliably using Instructor or Outlines. Backend & Microservice APIs FastAPI, asynchronous streaming, connection pooling, and Docker Comfortably writes async Python endpoints streaming tokens via SSE; explains how to containerize an application and manage GPU/CPU resource constraints. Evaluation & LLMOps Guardrails Synthetic benchmarking, hallucination metrics, and guardrail layers Articulates how to evaluate an LLM app using Ragas or TruLens; explains how NeMo Guardrails or regex/semantic filters prevent prompt injections.

jobs.description: Job Summary Job Description — AI/ML Engineer (Codibix Assistant) Location: Chennai Experience level: Senior — 8–12+ years Summary Owns the conversational Assistant end-to-end — a standalone Python/Node service, deliberately separate from the Java/Spring Boot core, that authors and validates knowledge-repository entries through a multi-agent architecture. This is the one genuinely novel, non-boilerplate part of the platform: not a CRUD app Claude can generate wholesale, but a governed agent system where every AI-drafted output must stay clearly distinguishable from human-authored content until a Reviewer approves it. Key Responsibilities Design and build the multi-agent architecture: Orchestrator/Router, Retrieval/Grounding (RAG), Authoring, Validation/Schema, and Explainer/Audit agents — each with a narrow, explicit job, not one do-everything LLM call Enforce the core guardrail in code, not just in the prompt: the Authoring agent drafts only, never auto-publishes — every AI-suggested entry must render visibly distinct from human-authored ones Build the tool-calling contract per agent (e.g., Authoring agent can call draft_entry() but never publish_entry()) — RBAC boundaries enforced at the tool layer, not hoped for in the system prompt Own the retrieval layer: embedding strategy, chunking, and query design against the shared PostgreSQL/pgvector store so drafts don't duplicate or contradict existing repository content Build and maintain the model-agnostic integration layer — the abstraction that makes "swap the underlying model, keep the same agent behavior" actually true in code, not just a slide claim Own the REST/gRPC API contract this service exposes to the Java core (owned jointly with the Solution Architect, who owns the consuming side of that same contract) Define and monitor agent-quality metrics — hallucination rate on drafted entries, retrieval relevance, false-approval risk on the Validation agent Partner with Domain Architects to validate that agent-drafted entries actually reflect real domain judgment, not plausible-sounding text Skill Requirements 5–8 years in ML/AI engineering, with direct experience building production LLM-based agent systems, not just prototype chatbots Hands-on experience with an agent orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and a clear point of view on why a graph/state-machine approach beats a single unstructured agent loop for governed use cases Strong Python or Node.js (matches whichever the Assistant service is ultimately built in) Experience with retrieval-augmented generation: embeddings, vector search (pgvector or equivalent), chunking strategy trade-offs Demonstrated ability to design guardrails that are structurally enforced, not prompt-only — this is the single most important skill for this role, given the platform's audit-trail requirements Comfortable owning a service boundary/API contract with a team building in a different language (Java) — this role does not need Java fluency, but does need to design a contract a Java consumer can integrate against cleanly Experience evaluating LLM output quality in production (not just offline benchmarks) — hallucination detection, relevance scoring, human-feedback loop design Must Have Skill Python,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),Vector Databases,Generative Artificial Intelligence,Machine Learning,Agentic AI Good to Have Skill Other Requirements Preferred Prior experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive domain where AI output requires traceability back to source Familiarity with Spring AI or LangChain4j (useful context for the API contract, even though this role doesn't build in Java) Experience building a correction/feedback loop that feeds structured signal back into a knowledge base, not just a thumbs-up/down Success Metrics Draft-to-approval rate (how often Reviewers accept vs. reject/heavily edit AI-drafted entries) — the most direct signal of whether the Assistant is actually helping Retrieval relevance (drafts genuinely grounded in existing repository content, not duplicated or contradicted)

jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) About the Team: Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code. Roles and Responsibilities: Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value. - Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready. Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize. Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not. Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation. - Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made. Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus what requires a platform build. - Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes. Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today. - Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling. All About You: Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients. - Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built. Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage. Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus. - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning. Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon. Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause. - Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker. Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped. Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Service Reliability Engineer- Apple Data Platforms
jobs.description: Summary The Apple Services Engineering team (ASE) is one of the most exciting examples of Apple's long-held passion for combining art and technology. These are the people who power the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books — at extensive scale, meeting high expectations to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. Within ASE, the Apple Data Platform SRE team keeps a massive, multi-cloud platform running for thousands of internal engineers building the next generation of data and AI products at Apple. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, and customer success — running incident response, providing hands-on support to internal teams, and partnering with developers to make cutting-edge services like Spark, Flink, Airflow, Trino, Druid, Notebooks, and LLM-based agent platforms reliable at scale. Description This is a rare opportunity to build deep expertise across one of the most technically diverse platforms at Apple — while specialising in the big data engines and catalog/governance layers that power analytics and data engineering across the company. As an SRE on Apple Data Platform, you'll operate and support the team's full portfolio, from ML/AI platform services to multi-cloud infrastructure, and grow into the team's go-to expert for big data platform services — including Spark, Flink, Airflow, Trino, Notebooks, REST Catalog services (such as Glue Catalog), and data governance. Just as importantly, you'll be a first point of contact for the internal customers who rely on these services daily — someone who can translate a confusing error or a vague support request into a clear diagnosis and a fast resolution. We're looking for a self-motivated engineer who thrives on ownership — someone who wants a set of services to call their own, the autonomy to drive their reliability roadmap, and the collaborative instinct to keep that work aligned with the team's broader direction. If you love solving hard operational problems, take genuine satisfaction in helping frustrated customers get unblocked, and want a front-row seat to how Apple's data engineering platform scales, this role offers real room to grow your scope and impact over time. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, an engineering-related field, or equivalent related experience. 6+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure-focused role. Proficient in scripting languages (Shell, Python) Deep understanding of one or more Big Data technologies (Spark, Flink, Airflow, Trino, Notebooks). Strong Experience with Kubernetes and AWS services- handling IAM (roles, policies, permission boundaries, KMS), EKS, RDS, S3 and cloud storage/networking fundamentals. Strong experience with implementing observability systems and practices: metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, SLOs, error budgets, and fault analysis at scale with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-expert customers. Solid grounding in SRE principles, with prior on-call, production-support, or customer-facing support role experience. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with MCP-based tooling and ML lifecycle/dataset management systems. Prior experience in a customer-facing or technical support role, with a demonstrated passion for customer success. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration and workflow scheduling patterns. Proficient in handling production databases and distributed-SQL engines with experience in Query Tuning and Optimizations. A track record of automating manual operations through scripting or tooling. Intellectual curiosity and a drive to keep learning — for yourself, your team, and the org. Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate prototyping, code generation, and documentation, and able to critically review and validate AI-generated output before it ships. At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. jobs.description: Overview: Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role requires you to be located in India. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team, dedicated to developing innovative solutions to make AI services responsible (Responsible AI). You will join the Responsible AI (RAI) & AI Safety engineering team. We are responsible for building, operating, and advancing the centralized AI safety, content moderation, and guardrail platforms powering Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo. Our systems run inline and asynchronously across high-throughput production workloads, detecting and mitigating jailbreaks, prompt injection, harmful content, bias, and policy violations while preserving latency and user experience. We partner closely with Product Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI Gateway, Legal, and Trust teams to deliver safety systems that scale globally. We have teams in the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and this will be our expansion to India. This team is responsible for building solutions and operating mature platforms to improve the entire company's security and trust & safety posture. If you are passionate about improving security, trust & safety, and combating abuse, this role presents a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact! Responsibilities: At Atlassian, a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) is responsible for building, training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models into production systems at scale. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering and data science, requiring production-grade code to turn research prototypes into real-world systems like search ranking, recommendations, and GenAI platforms. What You’ll Do Design & Productionize Safety Models: Architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM-based guardrail and moderation models (text, multi-modal, and code) to safeguard user inputs and model outputs across Atlassian products. Build Robust Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design offline and online evaluation frameworks, adversarial test suites (red-teaming), and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to measure precision, recall, false-positive rates, and robustness against model drift. Optimize for Real-Time Serving: Work at the intersection of model accuracy and low latency (P50/P99 targets) to deliver cost-effective, high-throughput safety filtering integrated with our central AI Gateway and inference layers. Combat Emerging Threats: Research and build defenses against adversarial prompts, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, and unauthorized tool-calling behaviors in agentic systems. Drive Global Compliance & Governance: Support technical readiness for enterprise standards and emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, ISO 42001 / AIMS, FedRAMP) through verifiable safety controls, audit logging, and watermarking capabilities. Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, data scientists, and product managers to steer technical strategy; provide code/design reviews and mentor junior engineers across the team. Compensation: At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. Qualifications: Your background Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with 7+ years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production. Deep hands-on experience with modern NLP and LLM techniques, transformer architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning (e.g., PEFT/LoRA), and model alignment. Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Kotlin, Java, or Go) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and performant production-grade code. Proven experience constructing rigorous evaluation pipelines, benchmarking datasets, and managing precision/recall trade-offs for high-consequence classification or safety systems. Expertise at telling stories with data and familiarity with at least one visualization tool (e.g. Tableau, R-Shiny, Microstrategy, SAP Business Objects, Looker, etc.) Experience deploying and scaling ML services in cloud environments (AWS / GCP) using containerized platforms (Kubernetes/Docker) and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, SQL). Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to navigate ambiguity, and clear communication skills to articulate ML trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. An agile development mindset focused on constant iteration, solving problems from first principles, and navigating ambiguity. It's great, but not required, if you have Experience specifically in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, or AI Red-Teaming / Adversarial Robustness. Hands-on experience optimizing inference engines (e.g., Triton Inference Server, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) or model quantization techniques for low-latency serving. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, content provenance/watermarking, or regulatory compliance standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001). Experience with large-scale streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or graph-based entity systems. Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. The role will have primary accountability for critical electrical systems while providing integrated leadership across cooling, fire protection, controls, water systems and other MEP services required to maintain continuous data center operations. The position will lead shift operations, maintenance planning, operating procedures, incident response, change control, vendor management, capacity monitoring and operational readiness. Manage facility engineers, shift teams, technicians, OEM representatives and specialist service providers. Establish clear operating roles, shift coverage, escalation paths, duty rosters and management-on-call arrangements. Ensure critical systems are operated within approved limits, redundancy requirements and tenant service commitments. Coordinate daily operations across electrical, mechanical, controls, fire protection, water and building systems. Ensure cooling systems maintain required supply temperature, flow, pressure, water quality and redundancy for high-density AI workloads. Monitor cooling performance, environmental conditions and interactions between IT load, electrical demand and heat rejection. Coordinate maintenance, flushing, filtration, chemical treatment and leak-response activities with mechanical specialists. Ensure electrical supplies, controls and emergency-response logic for cooling systems are maintained and tested. Support prioritization and controlled load management during degraded cooling or power conditions. 4. Standard Operating Procedures and Control of Work Develop, review and maintain standard operating procedures, methods of procedure, emergency operating procedures and checklists. Ensure all high-risk and critical work is planned, reviewed, approved and executed through formal control-of-work processes. Lead technical review of switching plans, shutdown plans, maintenance procedures and rollback arrangements. Implement permit-to-work, LOTO, access control and simultaneous-operations requirements in coordination with EHS and Security. Ensure pre-job briefings, peer checks, verification steps and post-work restoration checks are completed. Prevent unauthorized field changes or departures from approved operating procedures. 5. Preventive and Predictive Maintenance Develop and maintain preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance programs for MEP assets. Align maintenance frequencies with OEM recommendations, operating experience, asset criticality and regulatory requirements. Plan maintenance windows while preserving required redundancy and minimizing operational risk. Monitor thermography, oil tests, battery tests, vibration, water quality, insulation resistance and other condition-monitoring results. Ensure defects, overdue maintenance and temporary repairs are risk-assessed and tracked to permanent closure. Use maintenance data and failure history to improve reliability and optimize lifecycle cost. 6. Incident Response and Root-Cause Management Lead initial technical response to power, cooling, controls, fire-system and other MEP incidents. Proficient in Python, with strong knowledge of frontend development for agent UIs-React, TypeScript, APIs, authentication, and building reliable production systems. Experience integrating with business systems (CRMs, ERPs, HR platforms). Strong understanding of enterprise security, compliance, and data governance. Deep understanding of OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, and agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and Semantic Kernel. Knowledge of vector databases like MongoDB, Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant, Graph databased for knowledge representation.
